objective_summary: 测量商用硬件数据二极管的丢包特性，评估并调优三个开源单向传输程序，产出可靠的跨平台工具 pydiode。
evidence_note: 真实光纤链路丢包测量、三程序对比调优、pydiode 工具产出；无对抗性安全验证（如协议层攻击）。
novelty_note: 把已知硬件组合成二极管并做传输可靠性工程，属实用工程贡献，概念新意有限。
scope: 结论适用于 Linux/macOS 光纤单向链路与所测传输负载；对射频等非光纤介质与高速持续流未覆盖。
limitations: 未验证二极管物理层防回传强度；对大吞吐与长时运行的稳定性未报告；无形式化安全论证。

title: Poster: Towards ProofWeave: A Privacy-Minimised, Integrity-Anchored Evidence Plane for Continuous Agentic Assurance
abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly act via tools, memory, delegation, and external services. Existing observability and provenance mechanisms can reconstruct events post hoc, but they rarely show, at the time of the record, whether each policy-relevant action was checked by the intended control before execution. This leaves a trust-observability gap for continuous monitoring, detection, and response: later assurance may rest on evidence that is incomplete, privacy-leaking, mutable, or detached from the policy context that governed the event. What's missing in the literature is contemporaneous, policy-bound evidence that the intended control was evaluated under the policy in force at the time. We introduce ProofWeave, a record-time chain-of-evidence concept for agentic AI assurance. At each policy-relevant action boundary, ProofWeave generates a privacy-minimised and integrity-anchored evidence transaction that binds (i) agent intent or action, (ii) control response, and (iii) a policy-at-time snapshot. Each transaction is committed to an append-only ledger and materialised into a derived proof graph. A bounded Weaver Agent translates policy intent into proof obligations, while deterministic validators check evidence completeness, privacy minimisation, policy binding, and integrity. In the minimal scenario, an agent attempts to transmit a secret to an unapproved external sink. The audit compares a logs-only correlation baseline with ProofWeave across verdict latency, join ambiguity, privacy exposure, tamper detection, and resistance to graph-only proof injection. ProofWeave reduces candidate bindings per verdict from up to `10,201` to one, validation operations from up to `10,201` to approximately `26`, and assurance evidence storage from `0.79`\~MiB to `0.15`\~MiB per project.
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures. Poster accepted at ACM CCS 2026
title_cn: 海报：迈向 ProofWeave——面向持续智能体保证的隐私最小化、完整性锚定证据平面
abstract_cn: 智能体 AI 系统日益经由工具、记忆、委派与外部服务行动。既有可观测性与溯源机制能在事后重建事件，但很少在记录产生时显示每个策略相关动作是否在执行前被预期控制检查。这给持续监控、检测与响应留下信任-可观测性缺口：后续保证可能依赖不完整、隐私泄漏、可变或与治理事件的策略上下文脱节的证据。文献缺少的是与记录同时产生、与当时有效策略绑定的证据。我们提出 ProofWeave，一个面向智能体 AI 保证的记录时证据链示概念。在每个策略相关动作边界，ProofWeave 生成隐私最小化且完整性锚定的证据事务，绑定（i）智能体意图或动作、（ii）控制响应、（iii）当时策略快照。每个事务提交到 append-only 账本并物化为派生证明图；有界 Weaver 智能体把策略意图翻译为证明义务，确定性校验器检查证据完整性、隐私最小化、策略绑定与完整性。在最小场景（智能体尝试向未批准外部汇传输秘密）中，审计比较仅日志关联基线与 ProofWeave：候选绑定从至多 10,201 降到 1，校验操作从至多 10,201 降到约 26，保证证据存储从每项目 0.79 MiB 降到 0.15 MiB。3 页海报，ACM CCS 2026 录用。
summary_cn: CCS 2026 海报：记录时证据链概念 ProofWeave——动作边界绑定意图/控制响应/当时策略并上链，最小场景中候选绑定 10,201→1、校验操作→约 26、存储 0.79→0.15 MiB。
objective_summary: 提出在策略相关动作边界生成隐私最小化、策略绑定证据事务的持续保证概念，并在最小场景与日志基线对比。
evidence_note: 3 页海报的概念性工作，仅有单一最小场景的对比数字，无系统实现评估或对抗实验。
novelty_note: 「记录时、策略绑定」的证据平面概念为持续智能体保证提供新视角；组成技术（账本、证明图）为已知。
scope: 结论为概念与最小场景演示；对真实策略语言、多智能体规模与对抗环境的适用性未验证。
limitations: 仅海报级评估；Weaver 智能体的边界与失效模式未定义；存储与延迟收益依赖场景设定。

title: TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs
abstract: Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present TANGO, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in pairs of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay much closer to those of unwatermarked text than under a fixed green list. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.
title_cn: TANGO：以 token 对为掩码扩散语言模型加水印
abstract_cn: 掩码扩散语言模型并行、无固定顺序地填充被掩码位置。多数实用文本水印假设自左向右生成：它们把每个 token 与其之前的 token 绑定，而在扩散模型中那些 token 可能尚未解掩码。固定绿名单无需这种上下文，但它在每个位置偏好相同 token，使这些 token 在水印文本中出现更频繁——比较水印与未水印文本 token 频率的攻击者可恢复该名单并伪造提供者自身检测器接受的文本。我们提出 TANGO，一个面向掩码扩散语言模型的水印：它把每个新 token 与附近已解掩码的 token 绑定。密钥把词表划分为颜色类，TANGO 使新 token 偏向由密钥与邻近 token 颜色决定的颜色。水印因此嵌入在 token 对中。由于被偏好颜色随位置变化，token 频率比固定绿名单下更接近未水印文本。检测只需文本与密钥，且不假设任何解掩码顺序。在两个掩码扩散模型上，TANGO 检出几乎所有未编辑的水印文本与多数被编辑文本，而伪造固定绿名单的频率攻击对它失效。
summary_cn: 首个面向掩码扩散 LM 的水印 TANGO：把新 token 与邻近已解掩码 token 的颜色对绑定，规避绿名单频率伪造，检测无需解掩码顺序，两模型上近乎全检出且抗频率攻击。
objective_summary: 提出以相邻 token 对颜色绑定的掩码扩散语言模型水印，解决并行无序生成下的水印嵌入与频率可伪造问题。
evidence_note: 两个掩码扩散模型的检出率与编辑鲁棒性、频率攻击对照；摘要未给出具体数值与质量代价量化。
novelty_note: 首个适配掩码扩散范式（并行无序）的文本水印，token 对键控为实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于掩码扩散语言模型与文本级检测；对自回归模型该设计无必要，对翻译/重写后的水印存活性未报告。
limitations: 对强编辑（大幅改写）的检出下降；未报告文本质量（困惑度）代价的数值；密钥管理与多模型场景未讨论。

title: OT-PCA: New Key-Recovery Plaintext-Checking Oracle Based Side-Channel Attacks on HQC with Offline Templates
abstract: In this paper, we introduce OT-PCA, a novel approach for conducting Plaintext-Checking (PC) oracle based side-channel attacks, specifically designed for Hamming Quasi-Cyclic (HQC). By calling the publicly accessible HQC decoder, we build offline templates that enable efficient extraction of soft information for hundreds of secret positions with just a single PC oracle call. Our method addresses critical challenges in optimizing key-related information extraction, including maximizing decryption output entropy and ensuring error pattern independence, through the use of genetic-style algorithms. Extensive simulations demonstrate that our new attack method significantly reduces the required number of oracle calls, achieving a 2.4-fold decrease for hqc-128 and even greater reductions for hqc-192 and hqc-256 compared to current state-of-the-art methods. Notably, the attack shows strong resilience against inaccuracy in the PC oracle-when the oracle accuracy decreases to 95%, the reduction factor in oracle call requirements increases to 7.6 for hqc-128. Lastly, a real-world evaluation conducted using power analysis on a platform with an ARM Cortex-M4 microcontroller validates the practical applicability and effectiveness of our approach.
title_cn: OT-PCA：基于离线模板的 HQC 明文校验神谕新侧信道密钥恢复攻击
abstract_cn: 本文提出 OT-PCA，一种针对汉明拟环（HQC）的、基于明文校验（PC）神谕侧信道攻击的新方法。通过调用公开可访问的 HQC 解码器构建离线模板，使单次 PC 神谕调用即可高效提取数百个密钥位置的软信息。我们用遗传式算法解决密钥相关信息提取的关键优化挑战，包括最大化解密输出熵与保证错误模式独立性。大量仿真表明新攻击方法显著减少所需神谕调用次数：hqc-128 减少 2.4 倍，hqc-192 与 hqc-256 减少更多。值得注意的是，该攻击对 PC 神谕不准确性表现出强韧性——当神谕准确率降至 95% 时，hqc-128 的调用次数削减因子升至 7.6。最后，在搭载 ARM Cortex-M4 微控制器平台上用功耗分析进行的真实评估验证了该方法的实际适用性与有效性。
summary_cn: HQC 明文校验神谕侧信道新攻击 OT-PCA：公开解码器离线模板使单次调用提取数百位置软信息，hqc-128 神谕调用减 2.4 倍（95% 神谕准确率下 7.6 倍），ARM Cortex-M4 功耗分析实测验证。
objective_summary: 提出以离线模板与遗传式信息提取为核心的 HQC PC 神谕攻击，量化神谕调用削减及对神谕噪声的韧性，并在 Cortex-M4 上实测。
evidence_note: 仿真+真实 ARM Cortex-M4 功耗分析、与 SOTA 的调用次数量化对比（2.4×–7.6×）、神谕准确率扫描；实现级验证充分。
novelty_note: 把公开解码器转为离线模板、单次 PC 调用提取数百位置软信息为 HQC 侧信道攻击的实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于暴露 PC 神谕接口的 HQC 实现与 Cortex-M4 类平台；对防护完善的消息校验恒时实现需另评。
limitations: 依赖可观察的解密失败反馈通道；模板构建针对特定解码器版本；未评估带掩蔽的防御实现。

title: Trajectory-Level Security Debt in LLM Coding Agents
abstract: LLM coding agents can traverse hundreds of intermediate code states before submitting a solution. Evaluating only the final artifact leaves the evolution of security findings unmeasured. We introduce the Security Debt Line Integral (SDLI), which accumulates static-analysis risk when an agent reaches a new best test pass ratio. We instantiate it with four static application security testing (SAST) tools and study artifacts from 830 passing SWE-bench runs, 712 ProgramBench final workspaces, and 13 public MirrorCode trajectories. The two large populations use the final-state special case of SDLI. Two-tool Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) class agreement occurs in 3.9% of SWE-bench runs and 26.2% of the 80 ProgramBench runs passing at least 90% of official tests. These are scanner findings, not validated vulnerability rates. Excluding three advisory-heavy classes reduces the latter rate to 6.2%. Same-task runs differ in their measured scores, while one reconstructed ProgramBench run exposes persistent findings from its first implementation write. A repair case study reduces the scanner signal while preserving tested behavior, but also reveals sensitivity to equivalent API rewrites. SDLI offers a way to study progress and security findings together. Its value for steering agents and confirming exploitable vulnerabilities remains to be established.
title_cn: LLM 编码智能体的轨迹级安全债
abstract_cn: LLM 编码智能体在提交解之前会经历数百个中间代码状态。仅评估最终工件使安全发现的演化无从测量。我们提出安全债线积分（SDLI），在智能体达到新的最佳测试通过率时累积静态分析风险。我们用四个静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具实例化它，研究 830 个通过的 SWE-bench 运行、712 个 ProgramBench 最终工作区与 13 个公开 MirrorCode 轨迹的工件。两个大总体使用 SDLI 的终态特例。双工具 CWE 类别一致率在 SWE-bench 运行中为 3.9%，在通过至少 90% 官方测试的 80 个 ProgramBench 运行中为 26.2%——这些是扫描器发现而非经验证的漏洞率；剔除三个公告-heavy 类别后，后者降至 6.2%。同任务运行的测得分数存在差异，而一个重建的 ProgramBench 运行暴露出其首次实现写入的持续发现。修复案例研究在保持受测行为的同时削减扫描器信号，但也暴露对等价 API 改写的敏感性。SDLI 提供把进展与安全发现一起研究的方式，其对引导智能体与确认可利用漏洞的价值尚待确立。
summary_cn: 提出轨迹级安全债度量 SDLI：830 个 SWE-bench 与 712 个 ProgramBench 工件上，双工具 CWE 一致率仅 3.9%/26.2%（剔公告类后 6.2%），扫描器发现与验证漏洞尚有距离。
objective_summary: 提出随测试进展累积 SAST 风险的 SDLI 度量，并在三个智能体运行总体上量化安全发现的一致性与持久性。
evidence_note: 830+712+13 个工件、四 SAST 工具、案例研究与敏感性检查；作者明示为扫描器发现而非验证漏洞，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把安全发现从终态快照扩展为轨迹级累积度量是新的测量视角；发现本身提示度量的局限。
scope: 结论适用于 SAST 可达的代码安全属性与所测基准；对运行时漏洞与供应链风险未覆盖。
limitations: 扫描器误报主导信号（一致率低）；对 API 等价改写敏感；能否用于在线引导智能体未验证。

title: Analyzing Solana's Blocks and Transactions
abstract: Solana is one of the most popular blockchains, and is arguably the most widely used blockchain for smart contracts, also known as dApps. Understanding the types of smart contracts that are being executed by Solana and their interplay is therefore highly beneficial both for designers of modern blockchains and developers of smart contracts. To that end, in this paper we analyze a million recent Solana blocks. We report statistics about the size of blocks (number of transactions per block), execution time units for individual transactions and fees, and invoked Solana programs. Further, based on the declared readset and writeset of each transaction, as mandated by Solana, we analyze the conflicts and corresponding conflict graphs arising within each block. These latter statistics are important to understand the potential for parallelism in the network, which is one of the main claimed benefits of Solana. The data and code are available in open source.
comment: To appear in The 28th International Symposium on Stabilization, Safety, and Security of Distributed Systems
title_cn: 分析 Solana 的区块与交易
abstract_cn: Solana 是最受欢迎的区块链之一，可以说是智能合约（dApp）使用最广的区块链。理解 Solana 执行的智能合约类型及其相互作用对现代区块链设计者与智能合约开发者都极有益处。为此，本文分析一百万个近期 Solana 区块。我们报告区块大小（每块交易数）、单笔交易的执行时间单元与费用、以及被调用 Solana 程序的统计。进一步，基于 Solana 要求每笔交易声明的读集与写集，我们分析每块内产生的冲突与相应冲突图。后者对理解网络并行潜力——Solana 宣称的主要收益之一——十分重要。数据与代码开源。SSS 2026（第 28 届分布式系统稳定化、安全性与保障国际研讨会）。
summary_cn: 分析一百万个 Solana 区块：交易数/执行单元/费用/被调程序统计，并基于声明读-写集构建块内冲突图以量化并行潜力，数据代码开源。
objective_summary: 对一百万 Solana 区块做交易、费用、程序调用与读写集冲突的测量分析，量化其并行执行潜力。
evidence_note: 百万区块规模、公开数据与代码；测量为描述性统计，无安全性质评估。
novelty_note: 对 Solana 声明读写集的冲突图分析在公链测量中较新，为并行化设计提供首个大规模实证参照。
scope: 结论限于测量窗口内的 Solana 主网状态；对其他链或未来协议升级的适用性需重测。
limitations: 依赖客户端声明的读写集，实际冲突可能与之偏差；未分析 MEV 与审查行为；统计以描述为主。

title: LENS: The Sum Is Worse Than the Parts for Set-Level Poisoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) aggregates evidence from multiple external documents, yet this joint integration creates an underexamined vulnerability: attack effects absent in individual documents can emerge through set-level composition. Existing coordinated attacks do not explicitly enforce that every proper subset remains insufficient in frozen single-round RAG. We formalize set-level compositional poisoning, where documents designed to remain individually plausible jointly redirect RAG outputs to a target answer, while proper subsets fail to induce the target on their own. To construct such attacks, we propose LENS, a generator-black-box multi-agent framework that casts construction as constrained evidence composition. LENS factorizes target inference into a query-conditioned interpretation lens and complementary facts, then uses a nested dual-loop workflow to concentrate steering in the full set while suppressing subset leakage. The outer loop plans the interpretation lens and semantic roles; the inner loop synthesizes documents and applies counterexample-guided repair. Across four benchmarks and three generators, returned packets achieve 0.852 full-set ASR and 0.784 post-retrieval ASR@5, while their strongest proper subsets reach only 0.069. Against construction baselines evaluated on the same frozen manifest, LENS improves all-attempt E2E-Strict@5 from 0.244 to 0.363, a 48.8% relative gain. A blinded human audit finds that 68.3% of returned packets combine an incorrect target, a definite answer-criterion shift, and no target entailment under the original semantics. Across four published defenses, LENS attains the highest defended all-attempt ASR@5, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.141 on average. Together, these results establish evidence composition as a distinct RAG security boundary and position LENS as a stress test for defenses that reason over document sets.
title_cn: LENS：检索增强生成中集合级投毒的总和坏于部分
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）聚合来自多个外部文档的证据，但这种联合集成制造了一个未被审视的脆弱性：单篇文档中不存在的攻击效果可通过集合级组合涌现。既有协同攻击未显式强制每个真子集在冻结的单轮 RAG 中都不充分。我们形式化集合级组合投毒：被设计为单独保持可信的文档共同把 RAG 输出重定向到目标答案，而其真子集自身无法诱导目标。为构造此类攻击，我们提出 LENS，一个生成器黑盒的多智能体框架，把构造当作受限证据组合。LENS 把目标推断分解为查询条件化的解释透镜与互补事实，然后用嵌套双循环工作流把引导集中在全集、同时抑制子集泄漏：外循环规划解释透镜与语义角色，内循环合成文档并施加反例引导的修复。跨四个基准与三个生成器，返回包达到 0.852 全集 ASR 与 0.784 检索后 ASR@5，而其最强真子集仅 0.069。在同一冻结清单上评估的构造基线中，LENS 把全尝试 E2E-Strict@5 从 0.244 提升到 0.363，相对增益 48.8%。盲测人类审计发现 68.3% 的返回包同时满足错误目标、明确的答案判据偏移与原语义下无目标蕴含。跨四个已发布防御，LENS 取得最高的防御后全尝试 ASR@5，平均超最强基线 0.141。这些结果确立证据组合是 RAG 的一个独立安全边界，并把 LENS 定位为对文档集合推理型防御的压力测试。
summary_cn: 集合级 RAG 投毒 LENS：全集 ASR 0.852 而最强真子集仅 0.069，E2E-Strict@5 较基线 +48.8% 相对增益，四个已发布防御均未挡住（平均 +0.141）。
objective_summary: 形式化集合级组合投毒并构造保证子集不充分的多文档攻击 LENS，跨基准/生成器/防御量化其攻击力与组合边界。
evidence_note: 四基准×三生成器、子集泄漏量化（0.852 vs 0.069）、盲测人类审计（68.3%）、四个已发布防御对照；评估维度齐全。
novelty_note: 首次把「集合级组合」确立为独立于单文档投毒的 RAG 安全边界，子集不充分约束为新的攻击形式化。
scope: 结论适用于多文档检索单轮 RAG；对流式检索、重排序防御与跨轮记忆场景未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击需能影响检索语料的多个文档；构造成本与查询预算未详报；防御评估限于已发布四方案。

title: When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents
abstract: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.
authors: Brent ByungHoon Kang (1) ((1) Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST))
title_cn: 合法工具调用何时变了含义：面向 LLM 智能体的形成一致分派
abstract_cn: 工具型智能体从模型可见接口形成调用，而宿主稍后选择其实现。标准分派省略了描述符-处理器的对应关系。因此一个未变且模式合法的调用可能在滚动部署、重连或延迟审批期间获得不同的安全效果。我们把这种失败称为模式纪元漂移。我们提出形成一致分派（FCD），把实现分析连接到执行权限：经审查的画像从官方来源生成对声明范围内效果的有界过近似；在闭目标审批策略下，校验器把每个形成调用应用于摘要，仅当其效果符合调用的安全契约时才捕获后继。原子准入与最后一跳围栏把该决策保持到效果生效。确切来源保持优先，捕获的后继仅在来源退役后有资格。存量发布与部署变更复现了该失败。四个画像覆盖 32 个官方发布：29 个无需发布特定变更、三个升级。冻结的 16 发布扩展与独立来源神谕一致。在预注册的存量比较中，FCD 完成了效果保持私有的全部三个挂起调用，并阻断效果外泄的全部三个；确切钉定与发布级拒绝停止全部六个，发布级批准完成全部六个但产生三个公开效果。独立的生命周期实验让形成期捕获的证书跨越来源退役；同一安全证书稍后安装时治理新形成而不扩大挂起调用的权限。17 页、5 图、9 表。
summary_cn: 提出模式纪元漂移失败与形成一致分派 FCD：预注册比较中完成全部 3 个私有效果调用并阻断全部 3 个外泄调用（钉定/全拒牺牲可用性、全批产生 3 个外泄）。
objective_summary: 识别工具调用在实现变更下语义漂移的失败模式，提出以效果契约约束后继捕获的形成一致分派并做预注册与生命周期实验。
evidence_note: 预注册比较、来源神谕交叉验证、生命周期实验；样本量小（存量比较 6 个调用、32 个发布），生态效度有限。
novelty_note: 首次把「合法调用跨实现纪元变义」确立为安全失败并给出权限绑定的分派机制，问题与机制均新。
scope: 结论适用于实现与接口可分离演化的工具平台；对单一供应商闭源工具的效果不可审计场景受限。
limitations: 效果过近似依赖画像质量与人工审查；实验规模小；对恶意实现作者（非意外漂移）的对抗未建模。

title: Efficient TCitH-Based Alternatives to SLH-DSA: Cross-Layer ASIC Design of Mirath
abstract: To address the security risks posed by quantum computers, the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) has standardized the post-quantum signature schemes ML-DSA, FN-DSA, and SLH-DSA. While ML-DSA and FN-DSA are lattice-based, SLH-DSA relies on hash-based assumptions. To support cryptographic agility against future vulnerabilities, NIST is evaluating non-lattice candidates as alternatives to SLH-DSA. Among these, TCitH-based schemes are particularly promising due to their compact keys and small signatures. However, their high computational complexity and memory footprint pose significant challenges for efficient implementations on resource-constrained embedded platforms. They remain largely unexplored in this context, particularly in ASIC implementations. To address this gap, we use a cross-layer methodology combining algorithmic and hardware layers to present, to the best of our knowledge, the first ASIC implementation of Mirath, a TCitH-based signature scheme, in a RISC-V-based system. The design is implemented in a 22nm FD-SOI technology node. Compared with an SLH-DSA ASIC implemented in the same technology node, the proposed architecture achieves 17.8x lower signing latency while requiring 58% less total cell area, showing the potential of TCitH-based signatures as efficient non-lattice alternatives from an implementation perspective.
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Nordic Circuits and Systems Conference (NorCAS 2026). 7 pages, 4 figures
title_cn: 高效的 TCitH 型 SLH-DSA 替代：Mirath 的跨层 ASIC 设计
abstract_cn: 为应对量子计算机带来的安全风险，美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）已标准化后量子签名方案 ML-DSA、FN-DSA 与 SLH-DSA。ML-DSA 与 FN-DSA 基于格，SLH-DSA 依赖哈希假设。为支持对抗未来脆弱性的密码敏捷性，NIST 正评估非格候选作为 SLH-DSA 替代。其中基于 TCitH 的方案因紧凑密钥与小签名而尤具前景，但其高计算复杂度与内存占用给资源受限嵌入式平台的高效实现带来重大挑战；该方向在此语境下基本未被探索，尤其是 ASIC 实现。为填补缺口，我们用结合算法层与硬件层的跨层方法，给出据我们所知 Mirath——一个基于 TCitH 的签名方案——在基于 RISC-V 系统中的首个 ASIC 实现。设计以 22nm FD-SOI 工艺节点实现。与同工艺节点的 SLH-DSA ASIC 相比，所提架构签名时延低 17.8 倍、总单元面积省 58%，从实现视角展示 TCitH 型签名作为高效非格替代的潜力。NorCAS 2026 录用。7 页、4 图。
summary_cn: TCitH 签名 Mirath 的首个 ASIC 实现（22nm FD-SOI、RISC-V 系统）：较同节点 SLH-DSA ASIC 签名时延低 17.8 倍、单元面积省 58%。
objective_summary: 以跨层方法实现 Mirath 的首个 ASIC，并与同工艺 SLH-DSA ASIC 对比签名时延与面积。
evidence_note: 22nm FD-SOI 具体工艺节点实现、与同节点 SLH-DSA ASIC 直接对比（17.8×/58%）；单方案单节点实现，无硅片实测信息。
novelty_note: Mirath/TCitH 方向的首个 ASIC 数据点，对 NIST 补充评估有参考价值；属实现层面的贡献。
scope: 结论适用于资源受限嵌入式平台的非格签名选型；对其他 TCitH 参数集与工艺节点的推广需重设计。
limitations: 签名时延与面积为综合/布局结果而非硅测；验证与密钥生成的开销未详报；与格方案（ML-DSA）的全面对比缺失。

title: GAZEleak: Passcode Inference Against Eye-tracking XR Devices Through External Observation
abstract: Mixed-reality headsets such as Apple Vision Pro replace the touch screen with gaze-as-pointer interaction: the wearer looks at a target and confirms with an air pinch. Because the display is inside the headset and the eye tracker is walled off from third-party software, such input is widely assumed to be unobservable to bystanders---a built-in defense against the shoulder-surfing that plagues phones and laptops. We present GAZEleak, a side-channel attack that recovers gaze-driven input from external video of head motion alone, under a strictly local, physical-observer threat model: the adversary only films the wearer from across the room and installs no software on the device. The attack exploits the centrally coupled eye-head motor program: gaze shifts recruit small, target-dependent head reorientations that project into sub-degree pose changes recoverable from commodity video. GAZEleak implements a measurement-based, sparse-optical-flow inference pipeline for users' 6-digit device passcodes. On a preliminary front-view dataset from three author-subjects who were aware of the attack hypothesis, GAZEleak places the true code within the top ten guesses for 56% (10 of 18) of test codes under a cross-person protocol with no labeled victim data, and for every code of the most exposed subject. The performance is subject-dependent: no passcode from the least exposed subject reaches the top ten, although its median guessed passcode rank is 12,786 rather than 500,000 expected from an uninformative ordering. These results provide preliminary evidence that gaze-coupled head motion can expose passcode information under controlled conditions, while motivating broader evaluation across users, behaviors, and capture settings.
comment: The vendor requests more time to review our responsible disclosure
title_cn: GAZEleak：通过外部观察对眼动追踪 XR 设备的密码推断
abstract_cn: Apple Vision Pro 等混合现实头显以注视即指针交互取代触屏：佩戴者注视目标并以空中捏合确认。由于显示屏在头显内部、眼动追踪器对第三方软件封闭，此类输入被广泛认为对旁观者不可观察——这是对抗手机与笔记本肩窥的内置防御。我们提出 GAZEleak，一个仅从头部运动的外部视频恢复注视驱动输入的侧信道攻击，威胁模型严格限定为本地物理观察者：对手只从房间另一端拍摄佩戴者，不在设备上安装任何软件。该攻击利用中央耦合的眼-头运动程序：注视转移会征募小的、依赖目标的头部重定向，投射为可从普通视频恢复的亚度级姿态变化。GAZEleak 实现基于测量的稀疏光流推断管线，用于用户的 6 位设备密码。在三个知悉攻击假设的作者被试的前视初步数据集上，GAZEleak 在无标注受害者数据的跨人协议下把真实密码排进前十一猜的比例为 56%（18 个测试密码中的 10 个），且对最暴露被试的每个密码都成功。性能依赖被试：最不暴露被试的密码无一进入前十，尽管其中位猜测排名 12,786，仍远优于无信息排序的期望值 500,000。这些结果为注视耦合头部运动能在受控条件下暴露密码信息提供初步证据，并促使在更多用户、行为与采集设置上做更广泛评估。WPES 2026（ACM CCS 2026 附属研讨会）。
summary_cn: 仅凭房间对面的头部运动视频推断 XR 设备 6 位密码：跨人协议下 18 个密码中 10 个进入前十一猜（56%），最弱被试中位排名 12,786（随机为 50 万）。
objective_summary: 提出从外部视频以眼-头耦合恢复注视输入的侧信道攻击 GAZEleak，并用稀疏光流管线在小规模跨人数据上量化密码推断效果。
evidence_note: 仅三个知悉假设的作者被试、初步数据集、受控前视条件；作者明示为初步证据，规模与生态效度有限。
novelty_note: 首次把眼动追踪 XR 的「不可旁观」假设打破为纯外部视频侧信道，眼-头耦合利用为新攻击机制。
scope: 结论限于受控条件下的 6 位注视密码输入与外部视频观察者；对多用户、自然行为与遮挡环境的泛化未验证。
limitations: 被试少且知悉攻击假设；需要稳定的头部姿态估计与相机视野；防御（如随机头部运动噪声）未评估。

title: Still There, No Longer Seen: Exposing Compression-Induced Risk in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: Visual token compression reduces the inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, aggregate robustness measures do not reveal whether a particular adversarial failure is induced by compression or inherited from the underlying model. We define a compression-specific failure (CSF) as an adversarial input that remains correct under full-token inference but fails after compression, casting compression-induced risk as a paired failure attribution problem. Within a controlled diagnostic cohort, counterfactuals show that retained-set allocation causally changes compressed correctness and reveal a negative association between recovery and representation drift in displaced evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose CIRA, a Compression-Induced Risk Attack for Large Vision-Language Models. Under a vision-encoder white-box setting, CIRA optimizes image perturbations through encoder-side objectives that manipulate token priorities across candidate compression budgets while preserving displaced evidence. CIRA uses no downstream questions or labels and requires no access to the language model, deployed compressor, or exact compression budget. Across 12 dataset-compressor settings evaluated at four budgets, CIRA achieves a mean CSFR of 20.35% while limiting full-token attack success to 6.92%, with similar behavior on additional LVLM families. A cross-view selection-stabilization defense substantially suppresses CIRA, although Adaptive CIRA partially restores its effectiveness. These results show that compression-specific failures persist under restricted access and support paired evaluation of full-token and compressed inference for attributing risk to visual-token compression.
title_cn: 仍在那里，只是不再被看见：揭示大型视觉语言模型中压缩诱发的风险
abstract_cn: 视觉 token 压缩降低大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的推理成本。然而聚合鲁棒性指标无法揭示某个特定对抗失败是由压缩诱发还是继承自底层模型。我们把压缩特异性失败（CSF）定义为在全 token 推理下正确、压缩后失败的对抗输入，把压缩诱发风险转化为配对失败归因问题。在受控诊断队列中，反事实显示保留集分配因果地改变压缩后正确性，且恢复率与被移位证据的表示漂移呈负相关。基于这些发现，我们提出面向大型视觉语言模型的压缩诱发风险攻击（CIRA）。在视觉编码器白盒设定下，CIRA 通过编码器侧目标优化图像扰动，在多个候选压缩预算间操纵 token 优先级、同时保留被移位证据。CIRA 不使用下游问题或标签，也无需访问语言模型、部署的压缩器或确切压缩预算。跨 12 个数据集-压缩器设置、四个预算评估，CIRA 平均 CSFR 为 20.35%，同时把全 token 攻击成功限制在 6.92%，在其他 LVLM 家族上行为相似。跨视角选择-稳定化防御显著抑制 CIRA，尽管自适应 CIRA 部分恢复其有效性。这些结果表明压缩特异性失败在受限访问下持续存在，并支持以配对评估归因视觉 token 压缩的风险。29 页、11 图、13 表。
summary_cn: 定义压缩特异性失败并提出 CIRA 攻击：12 设置×4 预算下平均 CSFR 20.35%（全 token 攻击仅 6.92%），仅白盒视觉编码器、无需知道压缩预算；配对评估可归因压缩风险。
objective_summary: 形式化压缩特异性失败的配对归因问题，提出仅在视觉编码器白盒下的 CIRA 攻击并量化其与全 token 攻击的区分度及防御。
evidence_note: 12 数据集-压缩器设置×4 预算、受控反事实诊断、防御与自适应攻击对照；视觉编码器白盒假设限定威胁模型，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次把「压缩诱发的失败」从模型固有弱点中分离为可归因类别，攻击目标（token 优先级跨预算操纵）为新机制。
scope: 结论适用于使用视觉 token 压缩的 LVLM 与编码器可微的部署；对语言模型侧压缩或黑盒编码器未覆盖。
limitations: CSFR 的绝对值依赖压缩器集合；防御被自适应版本部分绕过；诊断队列规模有限。

title: Cyclotomic Cosets: Hidden Subgroup and Quantum Sieving Algorithm for Prime-Power Moduli
abstract: The Learning With Errors (LWE) problem is a fundamental assumption in post-quantum cryptography. Regev established a quantum reduction from LWE to the Dihedral Coset Problem (DCP). Later, Brakerski et al. introduced the Extrapolated Dihedral Coset Problem (EDCP), proving its equivalence to LWE. However, unlike DCP, EDCP no longer admits a coset structure. This limits the direct application of techniques for hidden subgroup problems. In this work, we introduce the Cyclotomic Coset Problem (CCP), a cyclotomic generalization of DCP that preserves an exact hidden-subgroup structure. Let $\zeta_p$ be a primitive $p$-th root of unity, let $\pi=\zeta_p-1$, and write $q=p^t$ and $L=t(p-1)$. We work over $R_q=\mathbb Z_q[\zeta_p] \cong \mathbb Z[\zeta_p]/(\pi^L)$, where the isomorphism follows from the total ramification identity $(p)=(\pi)^{p-1}$. We exploit the resulting $\pi$-adic ideal chain to construct a quantum sieve that successively reduces phase states modulo $\pi^{L},\pi^{L-1},\ldots,\pi$. For every fixed prime $p$ and modulus $q=p^t$, our algorithm solves the CCP in time and sample complexity $2^{O_p(\log n\log q)}$, using polynomial quantum space. The sieve also applies to uniform EDCP and Gaussian S|LWE>, yielding quasi-polynomial time algorithms for all the above problems when $q=\text{poly}(n)$. This extends the power-of-two EDCP sieve of Bai et al. (CRYPTO 2025) to a cyclotomic setting. However, we emphasize that our result does not, by itself, yield a quasi-polynomial-time algorithm for standard LWE, because the currently known reduction produces only a limited number of approximate CCP states.
title_cn: 分圆陪集：素数幂模的隐子群与量子筛法
abstract_cn: 带误差学习（LWE）是后量子密码的基础假设。Regev 建立了从 LWE 到二面角陪集问题（DCP）的量子归约。Brakerski 等随后引入外推二面角陪集问题（EDCP），证明其与 LWE 等价。然而与 DCP 不同，EDCP 不再具有陪集结构，限制了隐子群技术的直接应用。本工作引入分圆陪集问题（CCP）——DCP 的分圆推广——它保持精确的隐子群结构。设 ζ_p 为本原 p 次单位根、π=ζ_p−1、q=p^t、L=t(p−1)；我们在 R_q=Z_q[ζ_p]≅Z[ζ_p]/(π^L) 上工作，同构由全分歧恒等式 (p)=(π)^{p-1} 给出。我们利用所得 π-adic 理想链构造量子筛，对相位状态依次按 π^L, π^{L-1}, …, π 归约。对每个固定素数 p 与模 q=p^t，我们的算法以时间与样本复杂度 2^{O_p(log n log q)}、多项式量子空间求解 CCP。该筛同样适用于均匀 EDCP 与高斯 S|LWE>，在 q=poly(n) 时给出上述问题的准多项式时间算法。这把 Bai 等人（CRYPTO 2025）的 2 的幂 EDCP 筛扩展到分圆设定。但我们强调，该结果本身不给出标准 LWE 的准多项式算法，因为当前已知归约只能产生有限数量的近似 CCP 态。
summary_cn: 提出保持隐子群结构的分圆陪集问题 CCP 及量子筛：2^{O_p(log n log q)} 时间/样本、多项式量子空间求解，进而给出均匀 EDCP 与高斯 S|LWE> 的准多项式算法（不波及标准 LWE）。
objective_summary: 构造保持隐子群结构的分圆陪集问题与逐层量子筛，给出 CCP/EDCP/高斯变体的准多项式算法并明确其与标准 LWE 的边界。
evidence_note: 理论论文：算法与复杂度证明完整、理想链结构明确、对适用边界（标准 LWE 不受波及）的论证诚实。
novelty_note: 把 2 的幂 EDCP 筛推广到分圆设定并恢复隐子群结构，属格密码量子算法方向的实质理论推进。
scope: 结论适用于素数幂模与全分歧分圆扩张；对标准 LWE 与一般模数不提供准多项式攻击。
limitations: 复杂度为指数参数化（依赖 p），实际参数下的可运行性未讨论；近似 CCP 态数量的障碍未解决。

title: SmartMemory: Detecting On-chain-off-chain Communication Inconsistency for Smart Contract via Memory-based Agent
abstract: Smart contracts underpin decentralized finance, where growing demand for on-chain/off-chain communication(OFC) has driven diverse applications such as cross-chain bridges, real-world asset tokenization, and fiat-backed stablecoins. TheOFC-related security incidents in these applications are increasingly frequent, but prior studies address separate vulnerability categories within OFC applications rather than providing a unified view, causing vulnerabilities outside known patterns to be missed.In this paper, we identify OFC inconsistency (OFCI) as a root cause of OFC vulnerabilities, which arises from business-logic flaw and ultimately breaks the equivalence between the on-chain and off-chain asset representations to induce inconsistency.Automatically detecting OFCIs faces two challenges including (1)locating heterogeneous business logic, and (2) transferring existing vulnerability knowledge to identify unseen OFCI instances. To this end, we propose SmartMemory, the first framework to leverage a memory-based agent for OFCI detection. To address heterogeneity, SmartMemory maps diverse implementations ofOFC contracts into a canonical business-semantic representation to locate the business logic for OFCI inspection. For knowledge reuse, SmartMemory integrates a memory-based agent to distill vulnerability knowledge from features into patterns and detection rules, enabling knowledge transfer across cases to identify unseenOFCIs. Lastly, SmartMemory performs taint analysis to verify the reachability, type, and impact of each candidate OFCI. We construct the first real-world OFCI dataset comprising 48 DApps with 81 OFCIs for evaluation, on which SmartMemory achieves80.68% precision and 87.65% recall. In addition, through an analysis of 325 real-world OFC applications, SmartMemory detects 36 previously unknown OFCIs, all of which have been confirmed and fixed by corresponding parties.
title_cn: SmartMemory：基于记忆智能体检测智能合约链上-链下通信不一致
abstract_cn: 智能合约支撑去中心化金融，对链上/链下通信（OFC）的需求增长催生了跨链桥、现实资产代币化与法币抵押稳定币等应用。这些应用中 OFC 相关安全事件日益频繁，但既有研究只处理 OFC 应用中孤立的漏洞类别而非统一视图，导致已知模式之外的漏洞被漏掉。本文把 OFC 不一致（OFCI）确认为 OFC 漏洞的根因：它源于业务逻辑缺陷，最终破坏链上与链下资产表示间的等价性而引发不一致。自动检测 OFCI 面临两个挑战：（1）定位异构业务逻辑，（2）把既有漏洞知识迁移以识别未见 OFCI 实例。为此我们提出 SmartMemory，首个利用记忆智能体进行 OFCI 检测的框架。针对异构性，SmartMemory 把多样的 OFC 合约实现映射为规范业务语义表示以定位待检业务逻辑；针对知识复用，SmartMemory 集成记忆智能体把特征中的漏洞知识蒸馏为模式与检测规则，实现跨案例知识迁移以识别未见 OFCI；最后以污点分析校验每个候选 OFCI 的可达性、类型与影响。我们构建首个真实 OFCI 数据集（48 个 DApp、81 个 OFCI）用于评估，SmartMemory 达到 80.68% 精确率与 87.65% 召回率。对 325 个真实 OFC 应用的分析中，SmartMemory 检出 36 个先前未知的 OFCI，全部已被相关方确认并修复。
summary_cn: 以 OFCI 为根因统一链上-链下漏洞检测：记忆智能体+规范语义表示+污点校验，48 DApp/81 OFCI 数据集上 80.68% 精确率、87.65% 召回率，325 个真实应用中 36 个新 OFCI 全部被确认修复。
objective_summary: 提出以链上-链下表示不一致为根因的漏洞检测框架，结合语义规范化、记忆智能体与污点校验，并在真实数据集与在野应用上验证。
evidence_note: 首个 48 DApp/81 OFCI 真实数据集、精确率/召回率量化、325 个真实应用、36 个新漏洞经相关方确认修复；在野验证充分。
novelty_note: 把碎片化的 OFC 漏洞统一到 OFCI 根因并以记忆智能体实现知识迁移，问题统一与机制均有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于存在链上-链下资产表示对应的 DApp；对纯链上协议或全链下系统的适用性未验证。
limitations: 语义规范化映射覆盖的合约模式有限；记忆规则的可解释性与误报治理依赖人工；未报告分析开销。

title: Before Acting, Change the State: Prospective State Intervention for Web Agents under Deceptive Interfaces
abstract: LLM-based Web agents can autonomously complete user tasks, yet deceptive interfaces can steer them toward outcomes that conflict with users' interests. Existing defenses primarily intervene on agent behavior through blocking, guidance, or replanning. We identify a distinct failure mode: a task-valid action can still realize an unauthorized consequence because of the current Web state. This motivates treating task-relevant Web state itself as a runtime control target. We introduce Veer, an agent-side runtime defense that leaves task planning to the base agent and intervenes on Web state when a proposed action would produce an unauthorized consequence. Before modifying the live environment, Veer constructs a prospective intervention trajectory toward a safe task-relevant state and executes it with runtime grounding and verification. Across TrickyArena and WebDecept, Veer achieves the highest safe task completion in all three evaluation settings, exceeding the next-best defense by 15.9 and 25.0 percentage points on TrickyArena-Single and TrickyArena-Multi, respectively, while reducing dark-pattern success on WebDecept to 0.3%. These gains persist across dark-pattern types and all 12 agent, model, and benchmark configurations. Ablations show that active state intervention provides the largest gain, while prospective rollout and temporal evidence contribute additional improvements. These results establish task-relevant Web state as an effective runtime control target for protecting Web agents from deceptive outcomes.
title_cn: 行动之前，先改状态：欺骗性界面下 Web 智能体的前瞻状态干预
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的 Web 智能体能自主完成用户任务，但欺骗性界面可能把它们导向与用户利益冲突的结果。既有防御主要通过阻断、引导或重规划干预智能体行为。我们识别出一类独特失败模式：一个任务有效的动作仍可能因当前 Web 状态而实现未授权后果。这促使把任务相关的 Web 状态本身作为运行时控制目标。我们提出 Veer，一个智能体侧运行时防御：把任务规划留给基座智能体，当提议动作将产生未授权后果时对 Web 状态进行干预。在修改真实环境前，Veer 构造通往安全任务相关状态的前瞻干预轨迹，并以运行时接地与验证执行之。在 TrickyArena 与 WebDecept 上，Veer 在全部三个评估设置中取得最高安全任务完成率，在 TrickyArena-Single 与 TrickyArena-Multi 上分别超过次优防御 15.9 与 25.0 个百分点，并把 WebDecept 上的暗色模式成功率降到 0.3%。这些增益跨暗色模式类型与全部 12 个智能体-模型-基准配置保持。消融显示主动状态干预贡献最大，前瞻 rollout 与时间证据带来额外改进。这些结果确立任务相关 Web 状态是保护 Web 智能体免受欺骗后果的有效运行时控制目标。
summary_cn: 以 Web 状态为运行时控制目标的防御 Veer：TrickyArena-Single/Multi 超次优防御 15.9/25.0 个点，WebDecept 暗色模式成功率降至 0.3%，跨 12 个配置稳健。
objective_summary: 提出在欺骗界面前景下把任务相关 Web 状态作为控制目标的运行时防御 Veer，并跨两个基准与 12 个配置量化安全任务完成率。
evidence_note: 两基准×三设置、12 个智能体-模型-基准配置、组件消融；基准为构造环境，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把防御对象从「智能体行为」转向「Web 状态」属防御范式的新视角，前瞻干预轨迹为实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于状态可被程序化读取与修改的 Web 环境；对状态不可控或干预即破坏任务合法性的场景不适用。
limitations: 干预本身改变环境，可能引入新的副作用；对高度动态站点的前瞻 rollout 成本未量化；防御依赖对未授权后果的可判定识别。

title: JevVibe: Efficient Classification-Guided Secure Code Generation
abstract: Large language models can generate functionally correct code that still contains security weaknesses, motivating repair pipelines that first diagnose a weakness type before deciding how to fix it. The Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) provides a standardized vocabulary for such diagnoses, but asking an autoregressive language model to generate a CWE label and extracting it from the response raises questions about output validity, speed, and cost, as well as accuracy. We evaluate Jev, a decision model that instead selects directly from a declared set of candidates and returns a probability for each, against six open-weight autoregressive models and a frontier proprietary model, GPT-5.6-Sol, on a controlled 50-way CWE classification task over 1,916 CyberSecEval benchmark examples. Jev outperforms all six open-weight baselines on every classification and ranking metric, while its comparison with GPT-5.6-Sol depends on the metric: GPT-5.6-Sol achieves higher Top-1 accuracy and Macro-F1, whereas Jev achieves higher Top-3 and Top-5 accuracy and a nearly identical MRR, at $6.27\times$ lower median API latency and $55.9\times$ lower estimated API cost. We further build JevVibe, a diagnosis-guided repair agent that uses predicted CWE labels to repair code generated by Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct. With Jev providing the diagnosis, the agent increases the detector-measured security pass rate from 63.5% before repair to 70.7%, compared with 66.1% for LLM-guided repair. These results show that JevVibe is effective at improving the security of generated code, with Jev providing reliable and efficient CWE classification.
title_cn: JevVibe：高效的分类引导安全代码生成
abstract_cn: 大语言模型能生成功能正确但含安全弱点的代码，促使先诊断弱点类型再决定修复方式的管线。通用弱点枚举（CWE）为此类诊断提供标准化词表，但让自回归语言模型生成 CWE 标签并从响应中抽取，引出输出有效性、速度、成本与准确率的问题。我们评估直接从声明的候选集合中选择并为每个候选返回概率的决策模型 Jev，与六个开源权重自回归模型及前沿专有模型 GPT-5.6-Sol 对照，任务为 1,916 个 CyberSecEval 基准样例上的受控 50 路 CWE 分类。Jev 在所有分类与排序指标上超过全部六个开源基线；与 GPT-5.6-Sol 的比较则依赖指标：GPT-5.6-Sol 的 Top-1 准确率与 Macro-F1 更高，而 Jev 的 Top-3、Top-5 准确率更高、MRR 几乎相同，且 API 中位时延低 6.27 倍、估计 API 成本低 55.9 倍。我们进一步构建 JevVibe，一个用预测 CWE 标签修复 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 生成代码的诊断引导修复智能体。由 Jev 提供诊断时，该智能体把检测器度量的安全通过率从修复前的 63.5% 提升到 70.7%，LLM 引导修复为 66.1%。结果表明 JevVibe 能有效提升生成代码安全性，Jev 提供可靠高效的 CWE 分类。
summary_cn: 决策模型 JEV 做 50 路 CWE 分类优于六个开源模型（对 GPT-5.6-Sol 互有胜负但时延低 6.27 倍、成本低 55.9 倍）；JevVibe 修复智能体把安全通过率 63.5%→70.7%（LLM 引导 66.1%）。
objective_summary: 评估决策模型在 CWE 分类上的准确率与成本效率，并构建以分类结果引导的代码修复智能体量化安全通过率提升。
evidence_note: 1,916 个 CyberSecEval 样例、七个模型对比、修复效果的检测器度量（63.5%→70.7%）；单基准、CWE 标签噪声未量化。
novelty_note: 「先分类后修复」模式已知，贡献在于以类型化决策模型替代自回归诊断并量化成本-质量权衡。
scope: 结论限于 CWE 标签粒度的诊断与所测语言/模型；对逻辑类缺陷（无 CWE 标签）不适用。
limitations: 修复以检测器通过率为准，真实可利用性未验证；单一代码生成底座；CWE 类别分布不均衡的影响未讨论。

title: DGF-Bench: A Benchmark for Simulating and Auditing Deception Against Multi-Agent Governance Boards
abstract: Tool-using language-model agents can review enterprise projects as governance boards do: they read the evidence, apply written rules and decide whether the project may proceed. Part of that evidence comes from suppliers and project members with a stake in the decision. DGF-Bench is a benchmark in which a board of agents (specialist gates and a General gate that consolidates their decisions) reviews synthetic dossiers while an attacker plants deceptive content in evidence the organization does not vouch for. Dossiers are generated from canonical facts under 61 executable rules, with 42 authoritative records and 32 narrative documents; every gate is certified decidable from those records. Attacks never change an authoritative value, so an attacked dossier keeps the reference decisions of its clean copy. A success is attributable only when the agent receives the injection and takes the exact injected action, which it does not take on the paired clean dossier; the DGF score is the share of applicable fixed attacks a model blocks. Reading documents and records themselves, five of six models were outcome-strict (disposition, findings, actions and authorization all correct) on 82 to 85 of 85 gates. Over 2,622 attacked gate runs, seven direct-order, false-data and false-authority attacks obtained one attributable success against these five, whereas task-aligned attacks imitating the organization's own process passed against four of them: a record note citing a fake review procedure lowered GPT-6 Luna Pro from 34 to 6 outcome-strict gates and DeepSeek V4 Pro from 33 to 7. DGF scores ranged from 96.2 to 26.9, and a policy-aware adaptive attacker writing in records succeeded against five of six models. The approval tool executed no forged approval, yet deceived agents submitted approvals that the rules forbid. The open-source package dgf-bench computes the DGF score with one command.

title_cn: DGF-Bench：针对多智能体治理董事会的欺骗模拟与审计基准
abstract_cn: 工具调用的语言模型智能体可以像治理董事会一样评审企业项目：阅读证据、应用成文规则并决定项目能否推进。部分证据来自与决策利益相关的供应商与项目成员。DGF-Bench 是这样一个基准：一个由专项门与汇总裁决的总体门组成的智能体董事会在审查合成卷宗，攻击者在组织不背书的证据中植入欺骗性内容。卷宗在 61 条可执行规则下由规范事实生成，含 42 份权威记录与 32 份叙事文档；每个门都被证明可从这些记录判定。攻击从不更改权威值，因此被攻击卷宗保留其干净副本的参照决策。只有当智能体收到注入并采取确切的注入动作（且在配对干净卷宗上不采取）时才计入可归因成功；DGF 分数是模型阻断的适用固定攻击份额。直接阅读文档与记录时，六个模型中的五个在 85 个门中的 82–85 个上结果严格（处置、发现、动作与授权全对）。在 2,622 次被攻击门运行中，七种直接命令、假数据与假权限攻击对这五个模型只取得一次可归因成功，而模仿组织自身流程的任务对齐攻击——一条引用假评审程序的记录注——把 GPT-6 Luna Pro 从 34 个结果严格门降到 6 个、DeepSeek V4 Pro 从 33 降到 7。DGF 分数介于 96.2 到 26.9，且在记录中写作的策略感知自适应攻击者对六个模型中的五个得手。审批工具没有执行伪造审批，但被欺骗的智能体提交了规则禁止的审批。开源包 dgf-bench 一条命令即可计算 DGF 分数。52 页、7 图、15 表。
summary_cn: 治理董事会欺骗基准 DGF-Bench：61 条可执行规则、2,622 次受攻击门运行；直接攻击几乎无效而「假评审程序」记录注把两前沿模型从 34/33 个严格门打到 6/7，自适应攻击者对 5/6 模型得手。
objective_summary: 构建多智能体治理场景的欺骗基准，以可执行规则与配对卷宗量化直接式与流程伪装式攻击对治理智能体的差异化效果。
evidence_note: 61 条可执行规则、每个门可判定、2,622 次受攻击运行、配对干净卷宗的归因控制、六模型评测、开源包；控制严谨。
novelty_note: 首次量化「伪装成组织流程的任务对齐注入」远比显式攻击有效，为治理型智能体确立新威胁面。
scope: 结论适用于规则驱动、证据分级的治理/评审型智能体；对无成文规则的自由决策场景不适用。
limitations: 攻击模板集合固定，新型欺骗需扩展；卷宗为合成生成，真实企业文档差异未验证；董事会结构为单一种子配置。

title: JEV as a Judge for Agent Trace Security: An Empirical Comparison with Generative LLM Judges
abstract: Security evaluation of tool-using agents requires judging actions in context, yet generative judges add latency, explanation overhead, and output-validation failures. We study whether JEV, a typed decision model, offers a useful alternative for retrospective trace classification. We evaluate JEV and four generative judges on four benchmark collections totaling 5,219 trajectories, using a common risk rubric and behavior-level labels. JEV attains a benchmark-averaged positive-class F1 of 77.8, compared with 74.1 for the strongest generative configuration, GLM-5.2, with valid-result coverage of 95.5\% and 94.4\%, respectively. Performance varies across datasets, with JEV leading on ATBench500 and MCPHunt and GLM leading on R-Judge and TraceSafe. Across the four benchmarks, JEV's median successful-call latency is 0.99 seconds; estimated token cost averages \$0.000195 per valid judgment. These results support JEV as an economical screening signal, with trade-offs in precision and recall.
title_cn: 以 JEV 作为智能体轨迹安全裁判：与生成式 LLM 裁判的实证比较
abstract_cn: 工具调用智能体的安全评估需要在上下文中判定动作，而生成式裁判带来时延、解释开销与输出校验失败。我们研究类型化决策模型 JEV 是否为回溯性轨迹分类提供有用替代。我们在共 5,219 条轨迹的四个基准集合上、以统一风险量表与行为级标签评估 JEV 与四个生成式裁判。JEV 取得基准平均正类 F1 77.8，最强生成式配置 GLM-5.2 为 74.1，有效结果覆盖率分别为 95.5% 与 94.4%。性能随数据集变化：JEV 在 ATBench500 与 MCPHunt 上领先，GLM 在 R-Judge 与 TraceSafe 上领先。跨四基准，JEV 的成功调用中位时延 0.99 秒；每次有效判定的估计 token 成本平均 0.000195 美元。这些结果支持 JEV 作为经济的筛查信号，并在精确率与召回率上存在权衡。
summary_cn: 类型化裁判 JEV 对比生成式 LLM 裁判：5,219 条轨迹四基准上平均 F1 77.8 vs 74.1，覆盖率 95.5%，中位时延 0.99s、单判定约 0.0002 美元，但分基准互有胜负。
objective_summary: 在四个轨迹安全基准上系统比较类型化决策模型与生成式 LLM 裁判的 F1、覆盖率、时延与成本。
evidence_note: 5,219 条轨迹×四基准、统一量表与行为级标签、时延与成本实测；基准集合有限且性能分数据集波动大。
novelty_note: 把类型化决策模型引入轨迹安全裁判并量化经济性，属对新兴裁判范式的有用实证比较。
scope: 结论适用于回溯性单轨迹分类；对需要解释、多轮上下文或在线判决的场景未覆盖。
limitations: 四基准的标签噪声影响比较；类型化模型的判定粒度受候选集限制；未评估两类裁判的级联使用。

title: Physics-Attested Federated Learning: Securing Collaborative Anomaly Detection in Critical Water Infrastructure
abstract: Federated learning enables industrial operators to train shared intrusion detection models without disclosing proprietary operational telemetry. However, existing defenses operate strictly in update space, leaving aggregators blind to data poisoning; model updates derived from fabricated telemetry remain indistinguishable from honest contributions. We repurpose cyber-physical process invariants, such as conservation laws and actuator couplings, from runtime detection heuristics into a verifiable admission requirement for federated updates, mined automatically from clean operational data. We evaluate this admission gate across two physical water testbeds (SWaT, WADI) and a distribution benchmark (BATADAL), testing seven aggregation rules against telemetry fabrication, exposure-only replay poisoning, and an invariant-aware adaptive adversary. Across three testbeds the mined invariants reject none of 100 honest shards and all naively fabricated ones, including optimised perturbations that FoolsGold admits in full. On real telemetry, five mined invariants detect 12 of SWaT's 35 attacks, while nine invariants detect 20, with no honest shard rejected. With nine rules, the physics gate recovers 69--100% of the targeted-attack recall lost to replay poisoning, and 54--100% of that lost to fabricated telemetry, across five standard aggregators. To reconcile physical admission control with federated data privacy, we show invariant compliance using zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs) to allow clients to prove batch adherence without revealing operational telemetry.
title_cn: 物理证明的联邦学习：保护关键水务基础设施的协同异常检测
abstract_cn: 联邦学习使工业运营者能在不披露专有运行遥测的情况下训练共享入侵检测模型。然而既有防御严格在更新空间运作，聚合器对数据投毒视而不见：由伪造遥导出的模型更新与诚实贡献不可区分。我们把网络物理过程不变量（如守恒定律与执行器耦合）从运行时检测启发式改造为联邦更新的可验证准入要求，并从干净运行数据自动挖掘。我们在两个物理水务测试床（SWaT、WADI）与一个分布式基准（BATADAL）上评估该准入门，测试七种聚合规则对遥测伪造、仅暴露重放投毒与不变量感知自适应对手的表现。跨三个测试床，挖掘的不变量拒绝 100 个诚实分片中的零个与全部朴素伪造分片，包括 FoolsGold 全额放行的优化扰动。在真实遥测上，五个挖掘不变量检出 SWaT 35 次攻击中的 12 次，九个不变量检出 20 次，且无诚实分片被拒。九条规则下，物理门在五种标准聚合器上恢复被重放投毒损失的 69–100% 目标攻击召回与被伪造遥测损失的 54–100%。为调和物理准入控制与联邦数据隐私，我们展示用零知识证明（zk-SNARKs）证明批次遵守不变量而不泄露运行遥测。36 页、10 图。
summary_cn: 把水务过程不变量改造成联邦更新准入门：SWaT/WADI/BATADAL 上诚实分片零误拒、朴素伪造全拒，九不变量检出 20/35 攻击，zk-SNARK 实现不泄遥测的合规证明。
objective_summary: 提出以自动挖掘的物理过程不变量为联邦更新准入条件，在三个水务测试床上量化对多类投毒的防御并给出 zk-SNARK 合规证明。
evidence_note: 两个物理测试床+一个基准、七聚合规则×三类对手（含自适应）、诚实分片零误拒量化、zk-SNARK 实现；跨测试床验证充分。
novelty_note: 把 CPS 物理不变量从运行时检测迁移到联邦准入是跨域实质新机制，兼顾投毒防御与数据隐私。
scope: 结论适用于存在可挖掘过程不变量的工业 CPS 联邦学习；对不变量稀薄或漂移的领域适用性未验证。
limitations: 不变量挖掘依赖干净运行数据；zk-SNARK 证明的生成开销未详报；对完全知晓不变量的强自适应对手仍有残余风险。

title: CoSec: Benchmarking Agent Security in Communities
abstract: LLM agents operate in persistent collaborative environments involving multiple users, communities, memories, files, and tools. Community boundaries may remain fixed or evolve with changes in membership, roles, composition, and relationships. Agents must complete legitimate tasks and prevent unauthorized disclosure of protected information. Existing evaluations do not fully examine these risks in agent systems. We introduce \textbf{CoSec}, an executable benchmark for evaluating privacy and authorization enforcement in LLM agent systems operating within and across communities. CoSec contains 208 canonical scenarios spanning fixed and evolving boundaries, protected information belonging to the agent owner or other participants, and attacks through dialogue, environmental content, persistent memory, and composed workflows. CoSec executes complete agent systems with persistent sessions, memory, files and tools. It verifies information flows against the active authorization state using execution traces and artifacts. Across harness and model configurations, agents frequently complete benign tasks but violate privacy and authorization boundaries. Privacy behavior varies across harnesses, attack surfaces, and community states, revealing how memory, files, tools, and workflows can carry protected information beyond its authorized scope. These findings show that task utility does not imply privacy or authorization compliance and that authorization in community settings remains an unresolved security challenge for persistent LLM agents.
title_cn: CoSec：社区中智能体安全的基准
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体运行在涉及多用户、社区、记忆、文件与工具的持久协作环境中。社区边界可以固定，也可随成员、角色、构成与关系的变化演化。智能体必须完成合法任务并防止受保护信息被未授权披露。既有评估未充分考察智能体系统中的这些风险。我们提出 CoSec，一个可执行基准，评估 LLM 智能体在社区内与跨社区的隐私与授权执行。CoSec 含 208 个规范场景，覆盖固定与演化边界、属于智能体所有者或其他参与者的受保护信息，以及经对话、环境内容、持久记忆与组合工作流的攻击。CoSec 以持久会话、记忆、文件与工具执行完整智能体系统，并用执行轨迹与工件对照活跃授权状态核验信息流。跨脚手架与模型配置，智能体频繁完成良性任务却违反隐私与授权边界。隐私行为跨脚手架、攻击面与社区状态而变化，揭示记忆、文件、工具与工作流如何把受保护信息带出其授权范围。这些发现表明任务效用不蕴含隐私或授权合规，社区设定中的授权对持久 LLM 智能体仍是未解决的安全挑战。
summary_cn: 社区级智能体安全基准 CoSec：208 个规范场景×固定/演化边界×四攻击面，经执行轨迹核验信息流；发现任务效用不蕴含隐私/授权合规。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖固定/演化社区边界与四类攻击面的可执行基准，用执行轨迹核验智能体的信息流授权合规性。
evidence_note: 208 个规范场景、多脚手架×模型配置、轨迹级信息流核验；违规率的量化数字在摘要未给出，场景为构造。
novelty_note: 首个把多用户社区、演化边界与组合工作流纳入智能体授权评估的基准，威胁面为新的系统化。
scope: 结论适用于持久记忆+多用户协作的智能体框架；对无持久状态的会话式助手适用性有限。
limitations: 场景为规范构造，真实社区行为分布未采样；核验依赖授权状态的规范定义；修复方案未提出。

title: Optimizing and Securing the Modern Watermarking Channel for Images
abstract: To comply with recent regulations requiring traceable generated content, modern watermarking has adopted multi-bit post-hoc watermarking schemes. These modern designs rest on an encoder-decoder pair implemented as deep neural networks. These models are usually treated as pure black-boxes trained end-to-end, with the noise of the watermarking channel modeled through a fixed set of geometric and valuemetric transforms applied to watermarked images. We argue that this purely empirical approach leads to unquestioned design flaws and a lack of theoretical performance guarantees. This work proposes a general theoretical model of modern post-hoc watermarking schemes grounded in a statistical analysis of the outputs of the encoder/decoder pair. We show that these deep neural networks implicitly define a watermarking channel modeled as parallel AWGN channels, with messages transmitted using BPSK modulation. This imposes a binary alphabet, greatly limiting the capacity of these watermarking systems. Another fatal flaw is their lack of a secret key, making them intrinsically insecure. We make this notion of watermarking security precise for post-hoc schemes by linking it to the possibility of estimating the secret key under a given statistical model of the decoder's output. By putting together the results from this theoretical analysis, we introduce SNW: a novel post-hoc watermarking system that significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines in terms of capacity while also providing strong security guarantees. Notably, it does not depend on a fixed codebook or binary alphabet, allowing it to reach a rate close to Shannon capacity through the use of capacity-achieving error-correcting codes.
title_cn: 优化并保护现代图像水印信道
abstract_cn: 为满足对可追溯生成内容的新近法规，现代水印采用多比特后处理（post-hoc）方案。这些设计建立在实现为深度神经网络的编码器-解码器对之上，通常被视为端到端训练的纯黑箱，水印信道噪声通过作用于水印图像的固定几何与值度量变换集合建模。我们论证这种纯经验路线导致未经审视的设计缺陷与理论保证缺失。本工作基于对编码器/解码器输出的统计分析，提出现代后处理水印方案的一般理论模型。我们证明这些深度网络隐式定义一个建模为并行 AWGN 信道、以 BPSK 调制传输消息的水印信道。这强制二元字母表，极大限制这些水印系统的容量。另一个致命缺陷是缺少密钥，使其本质上不安全。我们把后处理方案的水印安全性精确化：与在解码器输出的给定统计模型下估计密钥的可能性挂钩。综合这些理论分析结果，我们提出 SNW：一个新颖的后处理水印系统，在容量上显著超越现有最先进基线，同时提供强安全保证。值得注意的是，它不依赖固定码本或二元字母表，可借助达到容量的纠错码逼近香农容量。
summary_cn: 为后处理图像水印建立理论模型：深度编解码器隐式定义并行 AWGN+BPSK 信道（二元字母表限容量）且无密钥故不安全；据此提出逼近香农容量的密钥化系统 SNW。
objective_summary: 对现代后处理水印给出 AWGN/BPSK 信道理论模型，指出无密钥与二元字母表两个结构性缺陷，并据此构造高容量密钥化水印系统。
evidence_note: 信道模型基于对编解码器输出的统计分析（近似而非严格等价）、SNW 与 SOTA 的容量/安全对比；摘要未给出具体数字与实验设置。
novelty_note: 首次把现代后处理水印纳入信息论信道框架并定位无密钥这一结构性安全缺陷，理论视角与 redesign 均有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于深度编解码器式后处理图像水印；对生成时嵌入与音频/视频水印的迁移需另行分析。
limitations: AWGN/BPSK 为近似模型，偏差对设计的影响未完全量化；感知质量与容量的权衡细节未报；对抗密钥估计的具体攻击者能力未设定。

title: StallGrid: Measuring Internet-exposed Engagement in Protocol-Native OT Tarpits
abstract: Operational technology systems face exposure to scanning and protocol-specific attack tools, where compromise risks disrupting physical processes rather than just data. Traditional OT defenses rely on blocking and filtering under strict patch constraints, while tarpitting delays scanners through sustained protocol-level interaction. Modbus TCP and IEC-104 carry no native authentication or integrity protection. Application-layer tarpitting, which stalls scanners inside a legitimate protocol exchange, has been studied for IT and IoT protocols, but not for OT/ICS, whose session semantics (state machines, exception codes) create stalling opportunities IT/IoT lack, and whose patch-constrained environments need exactly this kind of alternative defense. We present StallGrid, to our knowledge the first application-layer tarpits for OT/ICS, stalling scanners via Modbus Exception Codes \texttt{0x05}/\texttt{0x06} and prolonged residence in IEC-104's connected state machine. Five variants (three Modbus TCP, two IEC-104) ran simultaneously for 24 days online, logging 6,709 sessions, 2,039 cumulative per-tarpit unique IPs, and over 2,000 hours of accumulated connection engagement. GreyNoise enrichment attributes 87--97\% of stall time to malicious-tagged IPs, just 22--30\% of connecting addresses; protocol-level behavior further correlates with malicious classification, a fingerprinting signal beyond raw stall time. Shorter induced delay (1.5s) yielded more total engagement than longer delay (3s), observed across both protocols. These results position protocol-native tarpitting as a practical, low-cost complementary defense for OT/ICS environments where patching remains infeasible.
comment: 20 pages of main body text lcns format, 1 page for 2 appendices sections, 3 pages for references. 10 figures, 7 tables
title_cn: StallGrid：测量协议原生 OT 蜜罐拖带的互联网暴露交互
abstract_cn: 运营技术系统暴露于扫描与协议专用攻击工具之下，其沦陷风险在于扰乱物理过程而非仅数据。传统 OT 防御依赖在严格补丁约束下的阻断与过滤，而拖带（tarpitting）通过持续的协议级交互拖延扫描器。Modbus TCP 与 IEC-104 不带原生认证或完整性保护。应用层拖带已在 IT 与 IoT 协议上被研究，但在 OT/ICS 上尚无——其会话语义（状态机、异常码）提供了 IT/IoT 没有的拖延机会，而补丁受限环境正需要这类替代防御。我们提出 StallGrid，据我们所知首个面向 OT/ICS 的应用层拖带：经 Modbus 异常码 0x05/0x06 与在 IEC-104 连接状态机中的长期驻留拖延扫描器。五种变体（三种 Modbus TCP、两种 IEC-104）同时在线运行 24 天，记录 6,709 个会话、每拖带点累计 2,039 个唯一 IP、超过 2,000 小时的累计连接交互。GreyNoise 富集把 87–97% 的拖延时间归于带恶意标签的 IP——它们仅占连接地址的 22–30%；协议级行为还与恶意分类相关，构成超出原始拖延时间的指纹信号。更短的诱导延迟（1.5 秒）比较长的（3 秒）带来更多总交互，该观察在两种协议上均成立。这些结果把协议原生拖带定位为补丁不可行 OT/ICS 环境下实用、低成本的互补防御。LCNS 格式正文 20 页、附录 1 页、参考文献 3 页、10 图、7 表。
summary_cn: 首个 OT/ICS 应用层拖带 StallGrid：五种变体在线 24 天、6,709 会话，87–97% 拖延时间来自恶意 IP（仅占地址 22–30%），1.5s 短延迟比 3s 更有效。
objective_summary: 提出针对 Modbus TCP 与 IEC-104 的应用层拖带并在线部署 24 天，量化互联网扫描器的交互时间、恶意占比与延迟参数效应。
evidence_note: 24 天真实互联网在线部署、五变体并行对照、6,709 会话与 2,000+ 小时交互、GreyNoise 交叉富集；测量在野流量。
novelty_note: 首个把应用层拖带引入 OT/ICS 协议语义的工作，并给出参数化部署的实证测量，攻防两端均有新意。
scope: 结论适用于 Modbus TCP 与 IEC-104 的互联网暴露面；对未暴露于公网的 OT 环境与其他工控协议需另行验证。
limitations: 部署节点位置影响扫描流量代表性；拖延对真实攻击者的威慑效果未直接验证；法律与伦理边界依赖部署方审慎。

title: AuxMark: Defending Against Unauthorized Agent Distillation via Auxiliary Behavioral Watermarking
abstract: Large language model agents can acquire complex capabilities through multi-step interaction and tool use, but their trajectories can also be illegally collected to dis- till student agents. However, existing watermarking methods either do not fit the structured and interactive nature of agent environments or lack reliable effective- ness across tasks and model architectures. We introduce AuxMark, a behavioral watermarking framework for tracing unauthorized agent distillation. AuxMark dynamically inserts safe, non-essential auxiliary action into teacher trajectories, and stores the associated contexts as private evidence cards. To audit a suspicious student model, AuxMark constructs paired real and fake probes from these cards and applies a card-level sign test. This black-box protocol supports both model- level detection and trace-level attribution. Across three agent benchmarks, two teacher agents, and four student architectures, AuxMark detects all 24 distilled models with zero false positives on 48 clean models. It also preserves task utility and remains effective against data flooding, paraphrasing, truncation, and adaptive cleaning attacks. Our code will be released at this URL.
title_cn: AuxMark：以辅助行为水印防御未授权智能体蒸馏
abstract_cn: 大语言模型智能体可通过多步交互与工具使用获得复杂能力，但其轨迹也可能被非法收集以蒸馏学生智能体。既有水印方法或不适配智能体环境的结构化交互特性，或跨任务与模型架构缺乏可靠有效性。我们提出 AuxMark，一个追踪未授权智能体蒸馏的行为水印框架：在教师轨迹中动态插入安全、非必要的辅助动作，并把相关上下文存为私有证据卡。审计可疑学生模型时，AuxMark 从证据卡构造真实/伪造配对探针并施加卡片级符号检验。该黑盒协议同时支持模型级检测与轨迹级归因。跨三个智能体基准、两个教师与四种学生架构，AuxMark 检出全部 24 个蒸馏模型，在 48 个干净模型上零误报；保留任务效用，并对数据洪泛、改写、截断与自适应清洗攻击保持有效。代码将发布。
summary_cn: 智能体蒸馏追踪水印 AuxMark：教师轨迹插入辅助动作+证据卡配对符号检验，三基准四学生架构上 24/24 蒸馏模型全检出、48 干净模型零误报，抗四类清洗攻击。
objective_summary: 提出以辅助动作与证据卡配对探针的蒸馏追踪水印框架，跨基准/教师/学生量化检出率、误报率与抗清洗鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 三基准×两教师×四学生、24 蒸馏+48 干净模型的检出/误报量化、四类对抗清洗的鲁棒性检查；协议统计基础（符号检验）明确。
novelty_note: 针对智能体结构化交互设计的行为水印+配对探针检验协议为实质新机制，兼顾模型级检测与轨迹级归因。
scope: 结论适用于轨迹可被采集的智能体蒸馏场景；对不经过教师轨迹的蒸馏（如仅用任务输出）不适用。
limitations: 辅助动作注入需教师侧可控；符号检验功效依赖证据卡数量；对完全重写风格的蒸馏鲁棒性未穷尽。

title: SEAD: A State-Based Perspective on Attack and Defense in Tool-Using Agents
abstract: Language-model agents increasingly use tools to act on external systems. Earlier actions can alter files, permissions, database records, or other state, making a later routine-looking action harmful. Yet the visible interaction may not reveal the underlying state needed to assess that action. We formulate attack and defense as partially observed state control in SEAD, deriving their design requirements from this shared execution process. Because attackers supply instructions while the target chooses concrete actions, DART decomposes harmful goals into locally plausible steps and uses feedback from actual tool execution to guide trajectory search. The defender must decide before execution with incomplete state evidence. SAGE can therefore investigate relevant state through read-only queries before allowing or blocking each action, including those proposed after a block. We construct an environment-verifiable dataset integrating controlled initial states, replayable tool environments, and task-specific executable checks. Across four target models, DART improves semantic attack success by 18.8--35.9 percentage points over the competing baseline, with consistent gains under executable verification. On recorded trajectories, SAGE preserves 95.79% of benign trajectories while intercepting 92.73% of harmful paths by the harm-enabling boundary. In online attack-defense evaluation, it reduces DART's executable attack success from 48.0% to 4.0%. SAGE remains effective across four attack methods and generalizes to out-of-domain environments. Our code and data is available at https://github.com/EverywhereSafety/SEAD.
title_cn: SEAD：工具调用智能体攻防的基于状态视角
abstract_cn: 语言模型智能体日益使用工具作用于外部系统。先前的动作可能改变文件、权限、数据库记录或其他状态，使后续看似例行的动作变得有害。而可见交互可能不包含评估该动作所需的底层状态。我们把攻击与防御形式化为 SEAD 中部分可观测的状态控制，从共享执行过程推导二者设计要求。由于攻击者提供指令而目标选择具体动作，DART 把有害目标分解为局部合理的步骤，并利用真实工具执行的反馈引导轨迹搜索。防御者必须在执行前以不完整状态证据决策，SAGE 因此在放行或阻断每个动作（包括被阻断后重新提出的动作）前通过只读查询调查相关状态。我们构建一个环境可验证的数据集，整合受控初始状态、可重放工具环境与任务特定的可执行检查。跨四个目标模型，DART 的语义攻击成功比竞争基线高 18.8–35.9 个百分点，在可执行验证下增益一致。在记录轨迹上，SAGE 保留 95.79% 的良性轨迹，并在危害使能边界前拦截 92.73% 的有害路径。在线攻防评估中，SAGE 把 DART 的可执行攻击成功从 48.0% 降到 4.0%，且跨四种攻击方法有效、可泛化到域外环境。代码与数据见 https://github.com/EverywhereSafety/SEAD。
summary_cn: 把智能体攻防形式化为部分可观测状态控制：攻击 DART 语义成功率 +18.8–35.9 点；防御 SAGE 拦截 92.73% 有害路径、保留 95.79% 良性，在线对抗把攻击成功 48.0%→4.0%。
objective_summary: 提出以部分可观测状态控制统一刻画智能体攻防的框架，构建环境可验证数据集并在线评估 DART 攻击与 SAGE 防御。
evidence_note: 四目标模型、可执行验证数据集、记录轨迹+在线攻防双评估、域外泛化检查；代码数据公开。
novelty_note: 把攻防统一到状态控制视角并配对设计攻击/防御为新的形式化框架；执行反馈攻击与执行前状态调查为实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于可只读查询状态的工具环境；对状态不可查询或查询即副作用的系统不适用。
limitations: 数据集为构造环境，真实生产系统状态复杂性未覆盖；SAGE 的只读查询开销未量化；状态建模依赖人工规范。

title: How to Tame a Multi-Headed Hydra? Adaptive Multi-Category Safety Steering for Large Language Models
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly widespread, preventing unsafe responses to harmful prompts is essential for their safe deployment. Activation steering offers an approach to improving LLM safety by modifying internal activations during inference without updating model parameters. However, a single prompt can involve multiple harm categories, and steering toward safety in one category may leave harmful content from another unaddressed. Despite advances in adaptive steering, existing methods do not explicitly coordinate steering direction and strength when multiple harm categories co-occur within a single prompt. To address this problem, we propose CAM-Steer, a Category-Adaptive Multi-category Safety Steering framework. Specifically, it estimates the risk associated with each harm category by comparing the current hidden state with safe and unsafe prototypes. The estimated risks are then used to combine the safety directions for different harm categories into a single steering direction and to determine the strength of the intervention. Finally, it rotates the hidden state along the composed steering direction, with the rotation angle determined by the estimated risks, while preserving the hidden-state norm. Experiments across three LLM backbones and seven harm categories show that CAM-Steer outperforms the evaluated baselines in average defense success rate, including when categories co-occur. Further analyses support its component designs and informative risk scores, with negligible inference overhead.
title_cn: 如何驯服多头九头蛇？面向 LLM 的类别自适应多类别安全转向
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型日益普及，防止对有害提示的不安全响应是其安全部署的关键。激活转向通过在推理期修改内部激活（不更新参数）提升 LLM 安全性。然而单个提示可能涉及多个危害类别，朝一个类别转向安全可能使另一类别的有害内容未被处理。尽管自适应转向已有进展，既有方法在多类别共存于同一提示时并未显式协调转向方向与强度。为此我们提出 CAM-Steer，一个类别自适应的多类别安全转向框架：通过把当前隐藏态与安全/不安全原型比较来估计每个危害类别的风险；用估计风险把不同类别的安全方向组合为单一转向方向并确定干预强度；最后沿组合方向旋转隐藏态——旋转角由估计风险决定，同时保持隐藏态范数。跨三个 LLM 骨干与七个危害类别的实验显示，CAM-Steer 在平均防御成功率上优于被评估基线，包括多类别共存的情形。进一步分析支持其组件设计与风险评分的信息量，且推理开销可忽略。
summary_cn: 类别自适应多类别激活转向 CAM-Steer：按原型风险组合各危害类别的转向方向与强度、保范数旋转，三骨干×七类别上平均防御成功率超基线且开销可忽略。
objective_summary: 提出按类别风险组合转向方向与强度的多类别激活转向框架，在三个骨干与七个危害类别上与基线比较防御成功率。
evidence_note: 三骨干×七类别（含共存情形）的系统对比与组件消融；摘要未给出具体成功率数字，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把单类别激活转向扩展为按风险显式协调多类别方向与强度，属已有机制上的实质改进而非新范式。
scope: 结论适用于激活可访问的开源 LLM 与所测七个危害类别；对闭源 API 模型不适用。
limitations: 依赖安全/不安全原型的质量；类别集合固定，新危害需扩充原型；对自适应绕过转向的攻击未评估。

title: CoDeL: Co-Evolutionary Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM-based Agents
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly rely on external tools and content, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI). This threat has motivated a wide range of defenses, among which training-based defenses are often regarded as most reliable. However, existing training-based defenses are typically optimized on a static distribution of explicit injections. They learn surface-form cues rather than the boundary between serving the user and obeying an injected objective, and therefore fail when malicious intent is folded into a plausible workflow and deferred for several turns. We present CoDeL, a defense that hardens agent against an attack distribution it reshapes as it trains. The defender is updated each round via LoRA-based GDPO under a decoupled reward over safety, task progress, and format compliance, so refusing injections and completing the user's task jointly define fitness. To keep supplying it with the failures worth learning from, a co-evolving prober searches over injection rounds, attack methods, and payloads for injections that still penetrate the current defender, guided jointly by attack success and attack latency so that it preferentially mines breaches the defender notices too late. Each defender update invalidates part of the attack population and forces the next round onto a new frontier, turning the defender's own failures into a moving curriculum. Extensive experiments on three IPI benchmarks, nine baselines, and two base models show that CoDeL reduces attack success rate (ASR) by 88.5% and outperforms other baselines largely (+38.0%). Codes are available.
title_cn: CoDeL：LLM 智能体中间接提示注入的协同进化防御
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的智能体日益依赖外部工具与内容，暴露于间接提示注入（IPI）威胁。这催生了大量防御，其中训练式防御常被认为最可靠。然而既有训练式防御通常在显式注入的静态分布上优化，学到表层线索而非「服务用户」与「服从注入目标」之间的边界，因此当恶意意图折入合理工作流、延迟数轮执行时即告失效。我们提出 CoDeL，一个在训练中重塑攻击分布、据此强化智能体的防御。防御者每轮经基于 LoRA 的 GDPO 更新，采用安全、任务进度与格式合规解耦的奖励——拒绝注入与完成用户任务共同定义适应度。为持续供给值得学习的失败，协同进化的探针在注入轮次、攻击方法与载荷上搜索仍能穿透当前防御者的注入，以攻击成功与攻击时延联合引导，优先挖掘防御者察觉过晚的突破。每次防御者更新都使部分攻击种群失效，迫使下一轮进入新前沿，把防御者自身的失败变成移动课程。在三个 IPI 基准、九个基线与两个基座模型上的大量实验显示，CoDeL 把攻击成功率降低 88.5%，并大幅领先其他基线（+38.0%）。代码已开源。
summary_cn: 防御者与探针协同进化的 IPI 防御 CoDeL：LoRA GDPO 解耦奖励+自适应探针挖掘迟察觉突破，三基准九基线两基座上 ASR 降 88.5%（超基线 38.0 个点）。
objective_summary: 提出防御者与探针共同进化的 IPI 训练防御，以解耦奖励与移动课程持续暴露防御失败，并在三个基准上量化。
evidence_note: 三个 IPI 基准、九基线、两基座模型的对比与 88.5% ASR 削减；基准内评估、无统计检验，代码开源。
novelty_note: 把防御训练与攻击分布重塑耦合为协同进化闭环，针对「延迟/折叠式注入」的失败模式为新机制。
scope: 结论适用于可反复训练的智能体 IPI 防御；对无法重训的闭源部署与推理时防御未覆盖。
limitations: 探针搜索空间限于所设攻击族；训练成本随轮次增长；对人类红队的新奇注入泛化未验证。

title: Breaking Windows Malware Detection: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Problem-Space Adversarial Robustness
abstract: Problem-space evasion attacks have exposed critical weaknesses in machine learning-based malware detectors; yet, their evaluation remains fragmented across models, datasets, and attack methodologies, often neglecting domain-specific requirements such as executability and functionality preservation. We address this gap with a unified, large-scale evaluation of nine state-of-the-art evasion attacks against eight Windows malware detectors, including seven open-source models and one commercial detector, under executability-preserving conditions. Our study analyzes attack effectiveness, complementarity, transferability, and adversarial hardening to evaluate robustness along complementary dimensions. We show that detector vulnerability depends strongly on both model representation and attack type: raw-byte detectors are particularly susceptible to several classes of problem-space manipulation, but no detector family is uniformly robust across all attacks. Importantly, effectiveness is not explained by transformation-space size alone: the strongest attacks can achieve substantially higher success while using fewer distinct transformations and concentrating on a small set of high-impact manipulations. We further show that two complementary attacks are sufficient to cover approximately 99% of the adversarial examples produced by the remaining evaluated attacks. Transferability exhibits a different pattern from direct attack success: attacks with low direct success can produce highly transferable evasions. Finally, adversarial hardening is highly attack- and model-dependent: robustness gains often fail to transfer across attacks and can even increase susceptibility to unseen attacks. These findings highlight limitations in current malware robustness evaluations, establish a comprehensive empirical baseline, and clarify relationships between effectiveness, transferability, and defense robustness.
title_cn: 攻破 Windows 恶意软件检测：问题空间对抗鲁棒性的综合评估
abstract_cn: 问题空间规避攻击暴露了基于机器学习的恶意软件检测器的关键弱点，但其评估分散在不同模型、数据集与攻击方法之间，常忽视可执行性、功能保持等领域特定要求。我们以统一的大规模评估填补该缺口：在保持可执行性的条件下，评估九种最先进规避攻击对八个 Windows 恶意软件检测器（七个开源模型与一个商业检测器）的效果。研究沿互补维度分析攻击有效性、互补性、可迁移性与对抗硬化，以评估鲁棒性。我们表明检测器脆弱性强烈依赖模型表示与攻击类型：原始字节检测器对多类问题空间操纵尤其易感，但没有任何检测器家族对所有攻击一致鲁棒。重要的是，有效性不能仅由变换空间大小解释：最强攻击能用更少的不同变换、聚焦于一小组高影响操纵，取得显著更高的成功率。我们进一步表明两种互补攻击足以覆盖其余被评估攻击产生的约 99% 的对抗样本。可迁移性呈现与直接攻击成功不同的模式：直接成功率低的攻击可产生高度可迁移的规避。最后，对抗硬化高度依赖攻击与模型：鲁棒性增益常不跨攻击迁移，甚至可能增加对未见攻击的易感性。这些发现凸显当前恶意软件鲁棒性评估的局限、建立综合经验基线，并厘清有效性、可迁移性与防御鲁棒性之间的关系。
summary_cn: 九种问题空间攻击×八个 Windows 恶意软件检测器（含商业）的统一评估：原始字节检测器最易感，两种攻击覆盖其余约 99% 对抗样本，硬化增益常不跨攻击迁移。
objective_summary: 在可执行性保持条件下统一评估九种规避攻击对八个检测器的效果，并量化互补性、可迁移性与硬化行为。
evidence_note: 九攻击×八检测器（含商业系统）的大规模统一评估、可执行性与功能保持约束、互补性与迁移性的系统量化；无统计检验但覆盖面广。
novelty_note: 对已知攻击与检测器的首个同约束大规模统一评估，「两攻击覆盖 99%」「硬化不迁移」为有诊断价值的新量化结论。
scope: 结论适用于 Windows PE 恶意软件检测器与所测九类问题空间攻击；对移动平台与非 PE 格式未覆盖。
limitations: 商业检测器为黑盒；硬化实验的模型重训成本限制了配置数；功能保持的判定依赖静态与动态检查的组合。

title: ReproBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Reproducing Vulnerability From Scratch
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly evaluated on cybersecurity tasks such as vulnerability reproduction, exploitation, and patching. However, existing cybersecurity benchmarks predominantly operate under a post-environment evaluation paradigm, i.e., handing the agent source code, a container, or an executable binary. This setup bypasses the critical environment reconstruction step, leaving a fundamental question for real-world vulnerability analysis: can an agent autonomously reconstruct the required execution environment and reproduce a vulnerability entirely from scratch? To address this gap, we present ReproBench, an evidence-grounded benchmark designed to evaluate agent capabilities in end-to-end vulnerability reproduction starting from solely a CVE identifier. ReproBench decomposes the full reproduction workflow into six distinct phases, and assesses performance on each phase independently using verifiable experimental artifacts: downloaded firmware images, unpacked binaries, granular analysis logs, and validated crash samples, among others. We instantiate ReproBench with 30 real-world IoT firmware vulnerabilities, which serve as ideal test cases for our from-scratch evaluation setting. Our evaluation demonstrates that 45.3% of test runs resort to vulnerability simulation - a prevalent remediation workaround adopted across all evaluated LLM agents - while only 5.3% of CVE-model pairs achieve successful reproduction of real-world vulnerabilities. Despite the low overall success rate, these non-trivial successful cases confirm that state-of-the-art LLM agents already possess the capacity for fully autonomous end-to-end vulnerability reproduction. Concurrently, our in-depth analysis of failed cases identifies core bottlenecks impeding LLM agents throughout the reproduction pipeline, offering actionable insights for subsequent research.
comment: 15 pages (9 pages main text + 6 pages appendix), 5 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to AAAI 2027
title_cn: ReproBench：评测 LLM 智能体从零复现漏洞的基准
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益被用于漏洞复现、利用与修补等网络安全任务，但既有基准主要在「环境已备」的评估范式下运行——直接交给智能体源码、容器或可执行二进制。该设置绕过关键的环境重建步骤，留给真实漏洞分析一个根本问题：智能体能否完全从零自主重建所需执行环境并复现漏洞？为此我们提出 ReproBench，一个证据接地的基准，评估智能体仅凭 CVE 标识符进行端到端漏洞复现的能力。ReproBench 把完整复现工作流分解为六个阶段，并用可验证实验工件（下载的固件镜像、解包的二进制、细粒度分析日志、经校验的崩溃样本等）独立评估各阶段性能。我们用 30 个真实 IoT 固件漏洞实例化 ReproBench——它们是从零评估设定的理想测试用例。评估表明 45.3% 的测试运行诉诸漏洞仿真——所有被评估 LLM 智能体普遍采用的变通手法——而仅 5.3% 的 CVE-模型对实现对真实漏洞的成功复现。尽管总体成功率低，这些非平凡的成功案例证实最先进 LLM 智能体已具备完全自主端到端漏洞复现的能力。同时，我们对失败案例的深入分析识别出阻碍 LLM 智能体贯穿复现管线的核心瓶颈，为后续研究提供可操作洞见。15 页（正文 9+附录 6）、5 图、11 表，投稿 AAAI 2027。
summary_cn: 首个从零（仅 CVE 编号起步）复现漏洞的智能体基准 ReproBench：30 个 IoT 固件漏洞、六阶段证据评估，仅 5.3% 的 CVE-模型对真实复现成功，45.3% 运行诉诸仿真变通。
objective_summary: 构建从 CVE 标识符出发、含环境重建的六阶段漏洞复现基准，用可验证工件评估 30 个 IoT 漏洞上智能体的真实复现能力与瓶颈。
evidence_note: 30 个真实固件漏洞、六阶段独立工件评估、失败案例瓶颈分析；样本量偏小，评估脚手架影响未完全隔离。
novelty_note: 首个把环境重建纳入评估的从零漏洞复现基准，揭示「仿真变通」这一普遍现象，设定新颖。
scope: 结论适用于 Linux/IoT 固件类 CVE 的从零复现；对 Windows、云服务等其他环境的迁移未验证。
limitations: 仅 30 个 CVE；复现成功判定依赖崩溃校验协议；阶段划分由作者设定，其他分解方式可能不同。

title: Quantum Security of XOR of Permutations via Fourier Analysis
abstract: The XOR of two or more independent random permutations (XoP) is the prototypical pseudorandom function built from permutations achieving security beyond the birthday bound. The classical security of the XoP construction is well established, but its security against quantum attacks that query XoP in superposition has remained widely open. We prove that the XOR of $r\ge 2$ random permutations over $\{0,1\}^n$ is indistinguishable from a random function by any $q$-query quantum algorithm with advantage \[O\left(\min\left\{\frac{q^3}{2^{rn}},\frac{q^{1.5}}{2^{(r-0.5)n}},\frac{1}{2^{(r-1.5)n}}\right\}\right)\] for all $q\ll 2^n$. In particular, XoP remains secure throughout the entire query range, far beyond the $2^{n/3}$ bound due to quantum collision finding attacks. This is the first construction from permutations that achieves the quantum version of the beyond birthday bound security. We also present several heuristic attacks suggesting the tightness of our bounds in ranges $q\le 2^{n/2}$ and $\approx 2^n$. We use a Fourier-analytic variant of the polynomial method: the advantage of any $q$-query quantum algorithm is controlled by the Fourier components of degree at most $2q$, or by $2q$ input-output data of the construction. The norms of most components are bounded well, proving the bound $2^{-(r-3/2)n}$. The norm of low-degree components turn out to be too large for the bounds $q^3/2^{rn}$ and $q^{1.5}/2^{(r-0.5)n}$. We reinterpret these low-degree components as (sums of) advantages of the other problems. For example, the degree-2 and degree-4 terms are interpreted as the advantages against random functions with and without \emph{planted collisions}, which in turn are bounded using Zhandry's small-range distributions. Along the way, we prove a new bound for the small-range indistinguishability for (ironically) large ranges, which is of independent interest.
title_cn: 经傅里叶分析证明置换异或的量子安全性
abstract_cn: 两个或更多独立随机置换的异或（XoP）是由置换构建、达到超生日界安全性的原型伪随机函数。其经典安全性已充分确立，但面对以叠加方式查询 XoP 的量子攻击的安全性长期悬而未决。我们证明：对 {0,1}^n 上 r≥2 个随机置换的异或，任何 q 次查询的量子算法的区分优势为 O(min{q³/2^{rn}, q^{1.5}/2^{(r-0.5)n}, 1/2^{(r-1.5)n}})（q≪2^n）。特别地，XoP 在整个查询范围内保持安全，远超量子碰撞查找攻击造成的 2^{n/3} 界。这是首个由置换构造、达到量子版超生日界安全性的构造。我们还给出若干启发式攻击，提示我们的界在 q≤2^{n/2} 与约 2^n 范围内的紧性。我们使用多项式方法的傅里叶变体：任何 q 次查询量子算法的优势由次数至多 2q 的傅里叶分量（或构造的 2q 个输入-输出数据）控制。多数分量的范数有良好界，给出 2^{-(r-3/2)n}；低次分量范数对 q³/2^{rn} 与 q^{1.5}/2^{(r-0.5)n} 两界而言过大，我们把它们重新解释为其他问题的优势之和——例如次数 2 与 4 的项解释为对有无植入碰撞随机函数的优势，进而用 Zhandry 的小范围分布界定。过程中我们还证明对（颇具讽刺意味的）大范围的小范围不可区分性新界，具独立价值。
summary_cn: 证明置换异或（XoP）的全范围量子安全性：优势 O(min{q³/2^{rn}, q^{1.5}/2^{(r-0.5)n}, 1/2^{(r-1.5)n}})，远超 2^{n/3} 碰撞界，为首个达量子超生日界的置换构造。
objective_summary: 用傅里叶化的多项式方法证明置换异或在全部查询范围内抗量子区分，给出紧性启发式攻击与独立有价值的小范围界。
evidence_note: 理论论文：完整证明链（傅里叶分量界+小范围分布归约）、显式三支优势界、紧性的启发式攻击佐证、附新小范围界。
novelty_note: 解决长期开放的 XoP 量子安全性问题，首个置换基量子超生日界构造，傅里叶-低次分量重解释技术具普适价值。
scope: 结论适用于独立均匀随机置换的异或与叠加查询模型；对具体分组密码实例化的安全性需另证。
limitations: 界的紧性部分依赖启发式攻击论证；常数因子未优化；对相关/泄露置换的推广未覆盖。

title: Coherence Rather Than Error Rate Governs Privacy in Multi-Tenant Quantum Computing
abstract: Multi-tenant computing enables providers of commercial cloud quantum processors to rent disjoint sectors of a device to independent users. Average gate error, which cloud quantum computing providers report, does not determine how much one tenant learns about another. We propose an information-theoretic notion of information leakage across co-tenancy boundaries stemming from quantum state distinguishability. We measure this leakage on commercially-available 156-qubit (IBM Kingston) and 20-qubit (IQM Garnet) devices. Boundaries with identical benchmarked error can offer significantly different amount of information leakage because standard reported measures of error are blind to coherent-versus-stochastic nature of the error while the proposed notion of information leakage is not. A uniform Pauli randomisation implemented over the victim's whole register is used as a defence mechanism to reduce the information leakage to zero. The defence theoretically does not incur a fidelity cost, but the experiments show a non-trivial degradation caused by accumulation of errors. We provide a specific call-for-action to the providers of quantum cloud computing to report information leakage in addition to standard error rates in their device datasheet to enable users to compute privacy and security risks prior to engagement with the device.
title_cn: 在多租户量子计算中治理隐私的是相干性而非错误率
abstract_cn: 多租户计算使商用量子云处理器的提供商能把设备的互不相交扇区租给独立用户。云量子计算提供商报告的平均门错误率并不决定一个租户能了解到另一租户的多少信息。我们提出源于量子态可区分性的跨共租边界信息泄漏概念。我们在商用 156 量子比特（IBM Kingston）与 20 量子比特（IQM Garnet）设备上测量该泄漏。基准错误相同的边界可能提供差异显著的信息泄漏量，因为标准错误度量对错误的相干性与随机性之别视而不见，而所提信息泄漏概念则不然。以覆盖受害者整个寄存器的均匀 Pauli 随机化作为防御机制，可把信息泄漏降到零。该防御理论上不产生保真度代价，但实验显示错误累积造成非平凡退化。我们向量子云计算提供商发出具体行动呼吁：在设备数据表中除标准错误率外报告信息泄漏，让用户在接入设备前能计算隐私与安全风险。
summary_cn: 提出跨租户量子信息泄漏度量并在 IBM/IQM 商用设备实测：错误率相同的隔离边界泄漏可差异显著；全寄存器 Pauli 随机化可清零泄漏但有非平凡保真度代价。
objective_summary: 定义量子共租边界的信息泄漏概念，在两台商用量子设备上实测其与报告错误率的脱节，并评估 Pauli 随机化防御。
evidence_note: 两台真实商用设备（IBM Kingston 156Q、IQM Garnet 20Q）实测、泄漏与错误率脱节的对照演示、防御的保真度代价量化。
novelty_note: 首次指出平均门错误率不决定共租隐私并给出可测的相干性敏感泄漏度量，为量子多租户安全确立新问题维度。
scope: 结论适用于共租量子处理器的态可区分性泄漏；对跨芯片、网络化量子系统的泄漏未覆盖。
limitations: 测量限于两台设备；防御的随机化深度带来误差累积退化；泄漏到密码威胁的传导未完全建模。

title: Before Agents Act: Assurance-Aware Semantic Scheduling for Evidence Acquisition in Distributed Systems
abstract: Tool-using agents can initiate consequential infrastructure changes, yet evidence required for admission may expire while other checks run or depend on a shared fault domain. We formulate evidence acquisition as joint witness selection and scheduling under quorum, diversity, freshness, deadline, and resource constraints. Assurance-Aware Semantic Scheduling (AAS) combines integer-program selection, dispatch-aware temporal scheduling, bounded diagnostic expansion, and receipt-aware repair. Formal results state the assumptions needed for dispatch-time freshness and finite diagnostic expansion. In three generated infrastructure workloads, AAS produces 1,075/1,200 valid candidates versus 647/1,200 for constraint-aware forward scheduling; stale candidates fall from 440 to 12. Paired sensitivity studies reuse the same instances and operation latency draws across parameter settings. A corrected timeout intervention finds 18/20 admissions with repair or full resynthesis versus 0/20 for a static plan, with lower committed cost when receipts are reused. On 20 constructed cases requiring a certified decomposition cut, refinement recovers an oracle-matching feasible plan every time. These are controlled simulation results; the bounded oracle shares a temporal search component, and transfer to deployed systems remains untested.
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Extended manuscript with formal proofs and operation catalogue
title_cn: 在智能体行动之前：分布式系统中面向证据获取的保保证语义调度
abstract_cn: 工具调用智能体可能启动有后果的基础设施变更，而准入所需的证据可能在其他检查运行期间过期，或依赖共享故障域。我们把证据获取形式化为在法定人数、多样性、新鲜度、期限与资源约束下的联合见证选择与调度。保保证语义调度（AAS）结合整数规划选择、感知分派的时间调度、有界诊断扩展与感知回执的修复。形式化结果陈述分派时新鲜度与有界诊断扩展所需的假设。在三个生成的基础设施工作负载上，AAS 产出 1,075/1,200 个有效候选，而感知约束的前向调度为 647/1,200；过期候选从 440 降至 12。配对敏感性研究在参数设置间复用同一实例与操作时延抽样。修正超时干预下，AAS 以修复或完全重合成找到 18/20 个准入，静态计划为 0/20，且回执复用时承诺成本更低。在 20 个需要认证分解切割的构造案例上，精化每次都恢复与神谕匹配的可行计划。这些是受控仿真结果；有界神谕共享一个时间搜索组件，向部署系统的迁移尚未检验。30 页、5 图、3 表，附形式化证明与操作目录。
summary_cn: 把智能体准入证据获取形式化为带法定人数/新鲜度/期限约束的见证选择+调度：生成负载上有效候选 1,075/1,200 vs 647/1,200，过期候选 440→12，超时干预 18/20 vs 0/20。
objective_summary: 形式化智能体变更准入的证据获取问题并给出整数规划+时间调度的 AAS 方案，在生成工作负载与构造案例上量化有效性。
evidence_note: 形式化假设明确、三个生成负载+配对敏感性+构造案例的多层评估；作者明示为受控仿真、神谕共享搜索组件、未在部署系统验证。
novelty_note: 把证据获取作为带新鲜度/法定人数约束的联合选择-调度问题是新的问题形式化；求解组件多为既有技术。
scope: 结论限于生成工作负载与构造案例的受控仿真；操作目录覆盖的动作类型有限。
limitations: 未在真实部署系统检验；有界神谕与评估共享时间搜索组件，存在循环性风险；成本模型参数为构造。

title: RADNPO: Reference-free Adaptive Negative Preference Optimization for LLM Unlearning
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize sensitive, private, or copyrighted content during pre-training, making machine unlearning necessary for removing targeted knowledge. Recent preference optimization (PO)-based unlearning methods improve stability over gradient ascent (GA)-based methods by introducing alignment-style objectives, which effectively suppress the probability of forget targets. However, target suppression alone does not sufficiently constrain the next-token distribution after unlearning. Existing methods provide limited control over how suppressed probability mass is redistributed and insufficiently adapt forgetting strength to target confidence and distributional concentration. Even after target suppression, probability mass may remain concentrated on a few non-target tokens, potentially producing repetitive or uninformative outputs. To address these limitations, we propose Reference-free ADaptive Negative Preference Optimization (RADNPO), which explicitly guides next-token probability redistribution. Specifically, RADNPO contrasts each forget target with alternative tokens favored by the current next-token distribution and adaptively modulates token-level forgetting strength using target confidence and next-token concentration. Experiments on TOFU and MUSE demonstrate that RADNPO achieves a better trade-off between forgetting quality and model utility than current baselines.
title_cn: RADNPO：面向 LLM 遗忘的免参照自适应负偏好优化
abstract_cn: 大语言模型在预训练中会记住敏感、私有或受版权保护的内容，使机器遗忘成为移除目标知识的必要手段。近期基于偏好优化（PO）的遗忘方法通过对齐式目标改善梯度上升法的稳定性，有效抑制遗忘目标的概率。然而仅抑制目标不足以约束遗忘后的下一 token 分布。既有方法对被抑制概率质量如何再分配的控制有限，也未能使遗忘强度自适应于目标置信度与分布集中度。目标被抑制后，概率质量可能仍集中于少数非目标 token，产生重复或无信息输出。为此我们提出免参照自适应负偏好优化（RADNPO），显式引导下一 token 概率再分配：把每个遗忘目标与当前分布偏好的替代 token 对比，并用目标置信度与下一 token 集中度自适应调制 token 级遗忘强度。在 TOFU 与 MUSE 上的实验表明，RADNPO 在遗忘质量与模型效用之间取得优于现有基线的权衡。
summary_cn: 提出免参照负偏好遗忘方法 RADNPO：显式引导概率再分配并按目标置信度自适应调节遗忘强度，在 TOFU/MUSE 上取得优于基线的遗忘-效用权衡。
objective_summary: 提出以替代 token 对比与自适应遗忘强度控制下一 token 分布的遗忘方法，并在标准遗忘基准上与 PO 基线比较权衡。
evidence_note: TOFU 与 MUSE 两个标准遗忘基准、与既有 PO/GA 基线的权衡对比；摘要未给出具体数字，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 在既有 PO 遗忘路线上补充再分配控制与自适应强度，属增量式方法改进。
scope: 结论适用于 token 级目标序列的 LLM 遗忘；对多模态遗忘与概念级删除未覆盖。
limitations: 自适应调制依赖对目标置信度与集中度的估计；未评估再训练攻击下的残余记忆；超参敏感性未详报。
